Peter,

**Have I asked for too much?** I know that we’ve been emailing you asking for your support for over 500 days now, and in honesty, it’s only because of your generosity that we’ve been able to run the campaign that we have. But I’ve got to tell you, **with just 4 days left in this race, our momentum seems to be stalling.**

Yesterday we sent out an email asking for your help catching up with the strong fundraising numbers our opponent is putting up in the final stretch. **Just 10 of you reading this contributed.** When I saw that, my heart dropped. I don’t think I have to tell you that this is the worst possible time for the enthusiasm around our campaign to bottom out.

**According to early returns, nearly 30% of the electorate in my district has voted -- and despite a 9% Democrat advantage, we're down just 12,000 votes. 75% of independents in this race have still not returned their ballot, in addition to 64% of Republicans.**

While Democrats certainly have a small built-in advantage in this district thanks to redistricting, our plan is to win this race by turning out Republicans and winning more independent votes than our opponent. However, that cannot and will not happen without the resources to fully fund our field program this weekend. **[[Help fund our field program]](http://links.alekskarlatosforcongress.com/u/click?_t=7e7d86e0b42141418fdbf0bb715c41e9&_m=25319d81be18444a9f132e18a6364cf8&_e=vbOzEuV-bvEJC7MY7OGbfoK8ocC-a9apvD7SlCXlWZCfH1R4NLAsUc80HP0I2QRr0N0RqafW_Ld-Ez6QtcyykzVlwEcnhPs3ylgJTdBh2bn-rJHiKq1vrdtio0FAD-TN1BgrzwxQZGBElgg6VeDDvIg_d1osQw2eOYy0Ymjlfnx_URvl8d2vL_dEMWO_VMPG3EtvXkyRY68Lx7pu2Fznl_DHo1rwWKn1NRhSCTBZLtoA3RoKfheo3HUyyTgOhirCps-BHQEcR9bOB0n7jfb3MksboKraRQV0hSmAiUkC9UuFyCzGtjRrzBVQIiVKYFU1uSw9VhdfcSKvjYr9TAbD78bBnnoFY13Y5L-1q93UWFLmH90V3MI3JxnjWw1HgAljQ10sE_R_JZHoBDmWGDZI4g%3D%3D)**

What does that mean? Well, **it entails being able to pay 5-10 people to knock doors and contact voters around the district on behalf of my campaign; to make sure that everyone who can vote has/will vote before Tuesday.** We had set aside $6,000 for this program, but in the end had to move that money to fund our TV ADS when we fell well short of finding enough money to pay for both initiatives.

body:
Donald Trump is gunning for Doug Mastriano to be Pennsylvania’s next Governor for one reason: Doug will do anything to make sure that Trump wins in 2024.

| Hey team, it's Josh Shapiro.

Tomorrow, Donald Trump will be in Pennsylvania _again_ campaigning for my dangerous opponent, Doug Mastriano, and Dr. Oz. With just 3 days until Pennsylvanians head to the polls – this could be a make-or-break moment for our campaign.

Pennsylvania is no stranger to these two — in 2020, they worked together to try to overturn the results of a free and fair election. When they both failed, Doug Mastriano took matters into his own hands and bused people to our nation’s Capitol on January 6th. When the police told rioters to stand down, Mastriano crossed their barricades with the rioters.

[_**Look, it’s like I always say: we have to get everyone off the sidelines and in the game if we are going to beat Doug Mastriano on Election Day. Will you chip in today to combat the surge that Mastriano will get from Trump’s rally and to support Fight for Progress?**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/54082909/377341562/1150881829?refcode=BLU-FFP-20221104-2-EM&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjk2Yzk5MWNiLTljNWMtZWQxMS04MTljLTAwMjI0ODI1OGQyZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=7ILUMHwFKaAHgm9GhF2ehHmB6M-gljHSBrfMS1bKD48=)

# **Tom Patti Campaign Announces Election Day Activities**
---
|
---
| STOCKTON, CA - The campaign will be working right through Election Day to get out the vote until the polls close at 8 PM. The days’ events are below.

THERE IS MEDIA AVAILABILITY AT ALL EVENTS AND TOM WILL BE AVAILABLE FOR QUESTIONS:
* 8 AM - Supervisor Patti votes in person at the County Registrar of Voters, 44 N. San Joaquin Blvd.
* 9 AM - Supervisor Patti attends County Supervisor Meeting (in session all day, Tom available during lunch break only)
* 5 PM - Supervisor Patti greets voters at polling location (contact us for location TBD)
* 6 PM - Supervisor Patti joins phone bank at Campaign Headquarters, 3485 Brookside Road, # 102, Stockton, CA 95219
* 8 PM - Election Night Watch Party at Ave on the Mile, 2333 Pacific Avenue, Stockton
* 8:15 PM - Supervisor Patti arrives
* 10:30 PM - Supervisor Patti addresses supporters

---
|
---
| **About Supervisor Tom Patti:** Tom was raised in San Joaquin County and has run a successful local business for decades. He was elected to the San Joaquin County Board of Supervisors in 2016 by an overwhelming margin.

As a County Supervisor, community volunteer, and parent, Tom has worked and dedicated his efforts to safer neighborhoods, demanded real action to reduce homelessness, and advocated for improving the quality, accessibility, and availability of local healthcare.

Tom Patti has worked hard to support veterans, improve and fund our community colleges, support our farmers, advanced workforce equity and created many new job opportunities.

Hello human!

For the last six years, we've been lucky to be the very good girls of the Wexton household. We love our mom Jennifer so much for all the back scratches, belly rubs, and walks — all while she also does amazing and caring work to help her fellow humans. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54083509/377344998/-772585877?refcode=EM_FR_221104WLB_N_WLB_FULL_5_G_N_P1&fn=&ln=&em=dpwillis67@gmail.com&add1=&ci=Cresco&st=PA&pc=18326&oc=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NjYzM2ZjOC05ZDVjLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PYmYtejjSWBecVJWE_Eiyfqnds2fIrCxDhF5zrGMWUI=) We hear Jennifer talk a lot about how she helped pass important bills that will fix roads, make it easier for grown-up humans to care for little humans, and protect the air and plants that make the outside beautiful. We're so proud of her!

But now, there's another human who wants Jennifer's job. We hear he's a big fan of that dangerous angry orange man who used to be President, and that he doesn't think humans should be making their own decisions at the doctor's office. We don't want him to replace Jennifer!

**So we're lending a paw for Jennifer (because we are very smart and do know how to type on computers when the humans aren't looking). And we want to very politely ask:** [**can you chip in a few dollars for our mom right now? Peter, **According to a new poll, Raphael Warnock is winning the Georgia Senate race 61-34 among _early voters_.**

History shows us that Democrats prefer to vote early, and Republicans tend to vote on Election Day.

But let those polling numbers sink in for a moment. While most recent polls show this race is TIED, we would likely lose if Election Day voters (who tend to be more Republican) do not turn out to vote.

**_This is a CRITICAL REMINDER that we MUST WORK HARD in the final days to turn out our voters on Election Day._** We cannot be complacent or rely on a magical "Red Wave" to win. We must do the HARD and IMPORTANT work of contacting and turning out our voters.

We have not fully funded our budget for the final 72-hour push, so we desperately need your help. We must return our nation back towards being a “nation of laws, not of men” Please be sure to vote for my conservative campaign for Congress! name: Team Booker
subject: What the Early Vote means in Kentucky
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Booker for Kentucky
body:
[1]Charles Booker

Peter,

With just four days to go before Election Day, we are mobilizing hundreds
of thousands of Kentuckians to vote early. This is a relatively new and
uncommon practice in our Commonwealth.

Here's how We are sending millions of text messages to the people we’ve
identified as likely to vote Democrat in the midterm elections and giving
them their polling information.

Here’s the problem: large text messaging campaigns are expensive. And in
order to text our entire voter universe this weekend, we’ll need to spend
about $50,000.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18835?t=1001&akid=2722%2E346206%2EfJo9yE ]Can you chip in $20 or more to help us directly contact our voters in
Kentucky?

DONATE NOW →

This is important work. Direct voter contact is the best way to increase turnout
and get our voters to the polls. And in a state where more than half of
registered voters don’t usually vote, we need to use every tool we have
available to us to reach them.

By running up the margin in the early vote, we can head into Election Day with
an advantage Rand Paul can’t overcome.

Let's do this,

Team Booker HQ

Contribute to Charles Booker: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-email-donate?refcode=em20221104-2722-footer&t=1002&refcode2=2722_346206_fJo9yE&akid=2722%2E346206%2EfJo9yE

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe:

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:
http://act.charlesbooker.org/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=2722%2E346206%2EfJo9yE

Contributions to Booker for Kentucky are not deductible for federal income tax purposes.

Paid for by Booker for Kentucky

subject: Our plan is unraveling
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Alek For Oregon
body:
When I saw that only 10 donors made a gift to my campaign yesterday, my heart dropped. We don't have this race in the bag. We still need your help The only thing I’m guilty of is making my opponent and national Democrats spend money to defend a congressional seat they think belongs to them | [](http://links.alekskarlatosforcongress.com/u/click?_t=7e7d86e0b42141418fdbf0bb715c41e9&_m=4ff0710c8a47462b9a5c5e096ffb858c&_e=K6DxXdlD1agRv55LjBrZ-EUfmp_rKYf92J8_jlazHy_Zu6lUSCegB5dJA6Z1udkXFrbgI3LQeWAB2mCw7g1mmpuSOQe9GUIMYjsGdvWmdhRT-aOF63WvGAkyS74fg-A61o7XqK37Ytr7HpBPGJd5x7b9EIW6977o_xLFBpU3DtdPYYOWkkGuDwTrF23R3RO0nXD_ikFds7drV5CsuwrZI0_G1RPjVyvnjkujC0zny1wPVsyT49uEqRRmcA_d83MJAfAORAylLTTBotoRpQGMoZ5UsVEc3WZBBx8MhraAPpZDpKIOe2igFsyG7lnVr7xPo3tp1rsgcaH9GZkJUgMaokn0HlMUllq9p8sOGsLwTuDkvK01elqwFAa3T3f8IYbu7Gzr4i6HqdAG5iKJ9LQxQA%3D%3D)
---
Peter,

**Have I asked for too much?** I know that we’ve been emailing you asking for your support for over 500 days now, and in honesty, it’s only because of your generosity that we’ve been able to run the campaign that we have. But I’ve got to tell you, **with just 4 days left in this race, our momentum seems to be stalling.**

Yesterday we sent out an email asking for your help catching up with the strong fundraising numbers our opponent is putting up in the final stretch. **Just 10 of you reading this contributed.** When I saw that, my heart dropped. I don’t think I have to tell you that this is the worst possible time for the enthusiasm around our campaign to bottom out.

**According to early returns, nearly 30% of the electorate in my district has voted -- and despite a 9% Democrat advantage, we're down just 12,000 votes. 75% of independents in this race have still not returned their ballot, in addition to 64% of Republicans.**

While Democrats certainly have a small built-in advantage in this district thanks to redistricting, our plan is to win this race by turning out Republicans and winning more independent votes than our opponent. However, that cannot and will not happen without the resources to fully fund our field program this weekend. **[[Help fund our field program]](http://links.alekskarlatosforcongress.com/u/click?_t=7e7d86e0b42141418fdbf0bb715c41e9&_m=4ff0710c8a47462b9a5c5e096ffb858c&_e=K6DxXdlD1agRv55LjBrZ-EUfmp_rKYf92J8_jlazHy_Zu6lUSCegB5dJA6Z1udkXFrbgI3LQeWAB2mCw7g1mmpuSOQe9GUIMYjsGdvWmdhRT-aOF63WvGAkyS74fg-A61o7XqK37Ytr7HpBPGJd5x7b9EIW6977o_xLFBpU3DtdPYYOWkkGuDwTrF23R3RO0nXD_ikFds7drV5CsuwrZI0_G1RPjVyvnjkujC0zny1wPVsyT49uEqRRmcA_d83MJuJMS9B0DkO2QsdRv3OB_-QPxngBh7HxF0l0mI11MZKONONGrHc1hP5XRSFd5jKwN8VToZ8dvbku5oeNIdNQzgoX5llIWUs7p4WWQmyh3qYD6EtYbRAfiBFVzFosZSWkmmW5PAz3JnkfCntELZdAkyw%3D%3D)**

What does that mean? Well, **it entails being able to pay 5-10 people to knock doors and contact voters around the district on behalf of my campaign; to make sure that everyone who can vote has/will vote before Tuesday.** We had set aside $6,000 for this program, but in the end had to move that money to fund our TV ADS when we fell well short of finding enough money to pay for both initiatives.

**[Are you able to make one last investment in this campaign? If we fail to flip this seat on Tuesday, we probably never will...](http://links.alekskarlatosforcongress.com/u/click?_t=7e7d86e0b42141418fdbf0bb715c41e9&_m=4ff0710c8a47462b9a5c5e096ffb858c&_e=K6DxXdlD1agRv55LjBrZ-EUfmp_rKYf92J8_jlazHy_Zu6lUSCegB5dJA6Z1udkXFrbgI3LQeWAB2mCw7g1mmpuSOQe9GUIMYjsGdvWmdhRT-aOF63WvGAkyS74fg-A61o7XqK37Ytr7HpBPGJd5x7b9EIW6977o_xLFBpU3DtdPYYOWkkGuDwTrF23R3RO0nXD_ikFds7drV5CsuwrZI0_G1RPjVyvnjkujC0zny1wPVsyT49uEqRRmcA_d83MJ_UFn-YjBnWsfmkPB7jVtaIbmBCSlVFZ_PD1_J31b8uRxUHpm1Oj1q23odz-ACoLxUifFd5avDvHM--edqcjqAhEdTaCUxonHB7BPN-2IsNAY_T8ZA6O6aYf9jx6dDiWedgzKMqvbcQUvOhVw8pns_Q%3D%3D)**

We still need your help The only thing I’m guilty of is making my opponent and national Democrats spend money to defend a congressional seat they think belongs to them | Peter, Have I asked for too much? I know that we’ve been emailing you asking for your support for over 500 days now, and in honesty, it’s only because of your generosity that we’ve been able to run the campaign that we have. But I’ve got to tell you, with just 4 days left in this race, our momentum seems to be stalling. Yesterday we sent out an email asking for your help catching up with the strong fundraising numbers our opponent is putting up in the final stretch. Just 10 of you reading this contributed. When I saw that, my heart dropped. I don’t think I have to tell you that this is the worst possible time for the enthusiasm around our campaign to bottom out. According to early returns, nearly 30% of the electorate in my district has voted -- and despite a 9% Democrat advantage, we're down just 12,000 votes. 75% of independents in this race have still not returned their ballot, in addition to 64% of Republicans. While Democrats certainly have a small built-in advantage in this district thanks to redistricting, our plan is to win this race by turning out Republicans and winning more independent votes than our opponent. However, that cannot and will not happen without the resources to fully fund our field program this weekend. [[Help fund our field program]]() What does that mean? Well, it entails being able to pay 5-10 people to knock doors and contact voters around the district on behalf of my campaign; to make sure that everyone who can vote has/will vote before Tuesday. | | Peter, I am reaching out to you with a favor.

name: Vice President Mike Pence
subject: The power of prayer 🙏
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Advancing American Freedom
body:
| |
---
| | | | | [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61799429:6iUiy8GNe:m:1:3331421248:2B78A5F1C9FC2A39037613C2D2784EB2:r)
---

I'm convinced of two things: that America is a freedom-loving nation and America is a nation of faith.

Everywhere I go, people speak to me about their faith with a word of encouragement. The sweetest words I ever hear is when people say, "I'm praying for you." And I want you all to know: __Karen and I feel those prayers every day.__

Sadly, some activist judges and government bureaucrats want to make it harder for Americans to exercise their right to pray.

In fact, we recently saw a high school football coach get FIRED for privately praying on the field after a game.

I refused to just sit back and let our right to prayer be stripped away by big government.

Through my group, Advancing American Freedom, we petitioned the Supreme Court to reaffirm that coach's right to prayer. I'm pleased to report that the Supreme Court sided with the coach and reaffirmed all Americans' right to live out our faith.

_**But the fight is not over.**_

We must remain vigilant for the next attempt to restrict our right to pray. That's why I'm asking you to make a donation to Advancing American Freedom today to help us continue to defend religious freedom.

---
| | [CHIP IN TODAY](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61799429:6iUiy8GNe:m:1:3331421248:2B78A5F1C9FC2A39037613C2D2784EB2:r)
---

It is critical that we have the support of Americans who will never waver. _**[Whether you can spare $100 or just $25](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61799429:6iUiy8GNe:m:1:3331421248:2B78A5F1C9FC2A39037613C2D2784EB2:r "Whether you can spare $100 or just $10")**_ , I assure you we will never stop fighting to protect the right to pray.
_The Bible tells us that the prayer of the upright pleases Him; the prayer reaches Heaven, His holy dwelling place; and that in times of great challenge in our life or in the life of the nation, we 're not to be anxious about anything, but in everything, in every form of prayer and petition with thanksgiving, we're to present our request to God and know that the peace of God that passes all understanding will guard our hearts and minds in Christ Jesus._
So please step up today and help us protect the right to prayer. If you cannot give financially at this time, I understand, but I ask that you never stop praying for our country.

I appreciate all you have done and continue to do for our country.

God bless,
Mike Pence

---

body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zefuj37rhig20pp2887u3sqo0bfpuq7krvchj6i0_rp22sh2s8i66or7cdgm4ob7c1h238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8ddl69qbcd1jm8p79d9j6iprect66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2uepb2tjgmqqrao3mmsqeddj265pn8tlhear64s77cooj4cbmc5om9d73c4omcc77q9o74p1m62p6csjk65r61o5kckoe1d9hcjj6cphh6aqr6pti69j3aollm1jr1db5e8iv0)
This sponsored message from American Briefing is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zc7sgmn423srs29eg8fsrna8mhlg8lhfpbs7qreo_rp22sh2s8i66or7cdgm4ob7c1h2bs) Dear Fellow American, Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.” Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z295vo1jt3d2uphbocpuutqmqdk8ffa2cj35gdvg_rp22sh2s8i66or7cdgm4ob7c1h2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College. body:
| **Why are Bezos and Musk Investing Billions to ‘Transform’ the American Economy? And What Does It Mean for Your Money?** Something strange is happening behind the scenes in our financial system. Right now, the mainstream media is completely ignoring what might be the most important story in the financial world that nobody is talking about. Amid the distractions caused by conflicts overseas, shortages, and inflation, Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen recently took the stage at an event called COP26 in Glasgow, Scotland to address some of the world’s most powerful people, including:
* U.S. President, Joe Biden...
* British Prime Minister, Boris Johnson...
* Canadian Prime Minister, Justin Trudeau...
* French President, Emmanuel Macron...
* ... and many more...
From the stage, Yellen called for world leaders to commit to a [$150 trillion ‘global transition’ of our economy. ](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80351%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=F8fEnpkv6zJkUVLRdQNV5g&sysid=1) Since then, Bank of America has committed, along with 131 countries, 234 cities, and 695 of the world’s biggest companies. Several billionaires, led by Jeff Bezos and Elon Musk have invested in this ‘transformation’ as well. What is it that Yellen, Biden, Trudeau, Bezos and Musk are pushing for with their ‘transformation’? And what does it mean for your money? Investigative journalist and renowned economist, Nomi Prins, who predicted the 2008 market meltdown has followed the money... And what she’s discovered is startling. It has nothing to do with a market crash... a new reserve currency... or the end of fiat. Prins says: **“While most Americans are distracted by mainstream media headlines, I’ve found evidence the elites are spending $150 trillion to ‘transform’ our economy into something we didn’t vote on ... didn’t ask for... and very few are prepared for.** **In essence, we’re about to see a stranger, more extreme ‘new normal’ in America.** **Most people will be shocked when they see what happens in the months ahead.”** Prins considers this transformation so urgent, she has agreed to sit down for an interview to get her message in front of as many Americans as possible. For now, there’s no cost to watch. [Go here to see how this ‘transformation’ could affect you - and find out what it means for your money.](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80352%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=GJWwIiaeaKnPKNWgio0btg&sysid=1) [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80353%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=YSAUW%2foL3iupZBEFTbtm8A&sysid=1)

We cannot let my opponent roll back all of our progress and hurt Michigan families.

**[Before I dive deeper into the stakes of this race, I’m asking you to make a donation of $5 to my campaign today.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54087660/377383231/69088820?refcode=EM_FR_221105FRAM_N_GW_45DA_4_NG_N_L1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzcvMS85MDA5OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiODQxNzA4MC1mYzVjLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=25vNORzHJwU-Ah5wBYRrRtOPl3zOV660TJCVu479UhE=)**

My administration has delivered results: from fixing the damn roads to boosting our economy to making the largest investment in education in the state’s history to using every tool in our toolbox to defend the right to safe, legal abortion.

name: Eric H. Holder, Jr.
subject: Friend, the 2022 midterms are about monumental choices
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE NATIONAL REDISTRICTING ACTION FUND
body:
With so much at stake this November, I’m urging you to make sure you’re ready to make your voice heard again. Make a plan to vote, and help others do the same -- go to vote.org for more.
|
---

Friend --

The 2022 midterms are about monumental choices, including choices about democracy itself.

The work you have helped All On The Line accomplish has gone a long way toward strengthening our democracy. A recent _New York Times_ analysis found that the maps for the House of Representatives are the fairest in 40 years – and that’s because folks like you got involved and made your voices heard. But that doesn’t mean the work stops there. We need to not only protect the progress we have made, but also build on it.

**[With so much at stake this November, I’m urging you to make sure you’re ready to make your voice heard again. Make a plan to vote, and help others do the same -- go to vote.org for more.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/54088317/377385797/115938663?partner=885522&campaign=aotl-gotv-em/&refcode=20221105_AOTL_A_EHHGOTVResend_ActivesXOpeners&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjhkMTk1ZjYyLTAxNWQtZWQxMS04MTljLTAwMjI0ODI1OGQyZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=zvqjqnpFvHY8JraGdW_LnmkIASDHZ6iYpLKPMNK2nx4=&emci=bfd940cb-805c-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=8d195f62-015d-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=8431045)**
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/54088319/377385800/115938663?partner=885522&campaign=aotl-gotv-em/&refcode=20221105_AOTL_A_EHHGOTVResend_ActivesXOpeners&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjhkMTk1ZjYyLTAxNWQtZWQxMS04MTljLTAwMjI0ODI1OGQyZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=zvqjqnpFvHY8JraGdW_LnmkIASDHZ6iYpLKPMNK2nx4=&emci=bfd940cb-805c-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=8d195f62-015d-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=8431045)
---
**[Earlier this week I voted by mailing in my ballot -- join me in defending our democracy and make a plan to vote.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/54088322/377385802/115938663?partner=885522&campaign=aotl-gotv-em/&refcode=20221105_AOTL_A_EHHGOTVResend_ActivesXOpeners&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjhkMTk1ZjYyLTAxNWQtZWQxMS04MTljLTAwMjI0ODI1OGQyZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=zvqjqnpFvHY8JraGdW_LnmkIASDHZ6iYpLKPMNK2nx4=&emci=bfd940cb-805c-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=8d195f62-015d-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=8431045)**

This year, we have an opportunity to vote on terms that are, if not perfect, then closer to the ideals we have always told ourselves this nation stands for.

Like our imperfect union, the maps still need work -- and we’re counting on your support to continue that work. But in the short term, we need to focus on getting out to vote, and encouraging our friends and loved ones to do the same.

**Your vote -- and your right to vote -- directly affects other rights, too.** Whether it’s the right to choose, the right to love who you love, or the state-by-state rights about your ability to go to the polls on Election Day, everything is on the ballot this November. That’s how it is in a democracy, where we’re always one election away from long-lasting changes.

**[Make a plan to vote, and make your voice heard this November.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/54088324/377385805/115938663?partner=885522&campaign=aotl-gotv-em/&refcode=20221105_AOTL_A_EHHGOTVResend_ActivesXOpeners&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjhkMTk1ZjYyLTAxNWQtZWQxMS04MTljLTAwMjI0ODI1OGQyZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=zvqjqnpFvHY8JraGdW_LnmkIASDHZ6iYpLKPMNK2nx4=&emci=bfd940cb-805c-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=8d195f62-015d-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=8431045)**

In solidarity,

Eric H. Holder, Jr.

name: Pete Sepp
subject: Crime doesn’t pay… unless you’re in Congress
body:
Did you know that your taxpayer dollars fund the pensions of convicted congressional criminals?
[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zcacjob1q66v9voq5vi8p3j20ddngtttit6ql2p0_rp22sh2s8i66or7cdgm4ob6c9h2bs)
Hello Friend,

Did you know that your taxpayer dollars fund the pensions of convicted congressional criminals?

That's right. **Your hard-earned tax dollars are helping to support former members of Congress found guilty of crimes or serious ethical violations.**

A recent review of the cases of 11 congressional members convicted of criminal activity since 2007 who also qualified for a pension (plus the two members of the House censured for serious ethical violations) revealed some shocking information.

**All 13 convicted or censured congress members were still receiving their pensions, leaving taxpayers like you on the hook for nearly $4 MILLION total.**

How is that fair to you?

Let me introduce myself. My name is Pete Sepp, President of the National Taxpayers Union (NTU). We are fighting for taxpayers to revoke these privileges and rein in corruption.

[_**I am personally asking for your immediate help. My goal is to raise $13,000 _(or $1,000 per former lawmaker)_ this weekend so we can hold these congressional criminals accountable. Can you send a gift of $10, $35, $50, or any amount? Click here >>>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zv18klm80hq0cbvftitl9n6e054jrvpvh5o6u7q0_rp22sh2s8i66or7cdgm4ob6c9h2bs)

Fifteen years ago, Congress passed the Honest Leadership and Open Government Act (HLOGA) to stop Congressional felons from receiving a taxpayer-funded pension. Another, even "tougher" law followed in 2012.

**But so far, not a single congressional felon has faced the consequences of their actions.**

Right now, former Rep. Stephen Buyer, R-Ind., is having insider trading charges brought against him. IF he is convicted of those charges and his taxpayer-funded pension stripped, **he would be the first member of Congress ever held accountable under these laws.**

Obviously, the current pension forfeiture laws have not provided
adequate deterrence.

Reforms are needed to protect taxpayers and to shed transparency on enforcing forfeiture laws.

[_**Do you think we should protect taxpayers from subsidizing Congressional wrongdoers? You can help NTU put a STOP to this practice. All you have to do is send your urgent gift today >>>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zrhu8locaspp37t92iks9c5kft6kbeo64o2uenpg_rp22sh2s8i66or7cdgm4ob6c9h2bs)

Special interests have their lobbyists. But who is working for you as a taxpayer?

It's simple -- the National Taxpayers Union.

Since 1969, NTU has proudly been a major player in signature taxpayer victories of the past five decades:
* We were there when the federal tax code was overhauled under President Reagan in 1986.
* We championed the cause for a "Taxpayer Bill of Rights" in the late 80s and 90s and with follow-on legislation, the 2019 Taxpayer First Act.
* In 2017, NTU was the driving force behind the successful push for comprehensive tax reform.
* In 2020, our public education arm launched the Taxpayer Defense Center to fight for taxpayers in court. TDC has already helped to hand the IRS two major defeats in the Supreme Court.

It's time to stop wasting taxpayer dollars on corrupt politicians.

Can you join the fight and help NTU stop corruption and waste in DC? **Click below to send your gift. **

[_**Donate $10 >>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zft36hckc46d2dlepa721b03uo858s6ckttd7ik0_rp22sh2s8i66or7cdgm4ob6c9h2bs)
[_**Donate $35 >>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zfgad63dgmui2a0fiq19o2t3l8s55j2bfqckhd00_rp22sh2s8i66or7cdgm4ob6c9h2bs)
[_**Donate $50 >>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zlskivgihl4qfvd86tvqdfpncnufqfpp73pqt79g_rp22sh2s8i66or7cdgm4ob6c9h2bs)
[_**Donate $100 >>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z7ert87e5etion1mvuhvdrac36u2mr58aisphtug_rp22sh2s8i66or7cdgm4ob6c9h2bs)
[_**Donate $500 >>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zl8ovrsi86g98iaqk4pv5jvo9qr02mqj66dob370_rp22sh2s8i66or7cdgm4ob6c9h2bs)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zegkng4pbsbv8bci6jnh7btd81h6m9lt3opmn6i0_rp22sh2s8i66or7cdgm4ob6c9h2bs)

name: John Gomez  - Campaign Manager
subject: Chabot for Congress - Update from the Campaign Trail 11/4
body:
Our latest ad, visiting first responders and small businesses, and more!
No images? [Click here](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-e-tjjilyid-kujkulhluu-z/) [](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjjilyid-kujkulhluu-r/)
# Update from the Campaign Trail 11/4/22
Good evening,We are just 4 days out from Election Day 2022. Team Chabot is sprinting through the finish line and not letting a second go to waste. This week, we released our fifth ad, titled "Barry". Congressman Chabot has been traveling the district, knocking doors, and meeting with first responders and small business owners. Read on for these updates and more from the trail! **_Congressman Chabot on the Trail_** _Congressman Chabot Knocking Doors_ Despite some rainy weather on Sunday, Congressman Chabot still hit the trail and knocked doors. This weekend, Congressman Chabot knocked doors in Norwood and in Evendale. Team Chabot has been knocking across the district with teams in nearly every community. Team Chabot continues to pound the pavement and have officially crossed **one million voter contacts** and continue to work hard through Election Day. _OH-01 Door Launches_ This weekend, Congressman Chabot joined Senator Rob Portman, Gov. Mike DeWine, and JD Vance in Sharonville to kick off a major day of door knocking. Senator Portman and Congressman Chabot greeted volunteers at our Campaign Headquarters later that morning, launching even more volunteers on their way to knock doors.Our volunteers are fired up and have been working hard across the district! _NEW AD - "Barry"_This week we released our fifth ad, titled "Barry". In the ad a local small business owner highlights Greg Landsman's record of increasing the burden on families and small businesses."Hardworking families and small businesses feeling the squeeze of rising costs simply can't afford another tax-and-spend politician like Greg Landsman who has a demonstrated track record of increasing the burden. As small businesses worked to recover from the pandemic, Landsman introduced a plan to slap them with arbitrary and damaging mandates -- and as families and small businesses faced rising costs as a result of the unchecked Biden-Pelosi agenda in Washington, Landsman voted to increase taxes eight times on the Cincinnati City Council."Read more about the ad [here](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjjilyid-kujkulhluu-y/). [](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjjilyid-kujkulhluu-j/) _Congressman Chabot on Fox News_ On Saturday, Congressman Chabot joined Fox News Live to discuss the race, inflation, rising crime, and Greg Landsman's record of failure.Watch the full interview [here](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjjilyid-kujkulhluu-t/). _Immanuel Church of Christ Fall Festival_ On Sunday, Congressman Chabot attended the Immanuel Church of Christ Fall Festival in St. Bernard. The rain moved the festival inside but everyone was still enjoying spending time together as a community. _Visit to Mike Castrucci Chrysler Dodge Jeep Ram_This week Congressman Chabot visited Mike Castrucci Chrysler Dodge Jeep and Ram in Fairfax. Congressman Chabot has spent his career fighting for small businesses in Washington and always happy when he has the opportunity to visit with job creators in our community. _Delivering Cups to First Responders_ Congressman Chabot has been traveling throughout the district, meeting with local first responders to thank them for their service and to hear about the ways that Congress can better support them. We're eternally grateful for their service and the sacrifices they make. **_Early Voting Information_** Early voting is officially here. Early voting is a safe, secure, and convenient way to make sure you get your ballot in without having to worry about any unexpected challenges on Election Day.Congressman Chabot spent some time this week at both Hamilton County and Warren County's Board of Elections handing out slate cards and talking to voters. A lot of great energy and excited voters!Early voting takes place at your county Board of Elections. This week, there is early voting occurring on both Saturday and Sunday. I included their addresses below:_Hamilton County Board of Elections_ - 4700 Smith Road, Cincinnati, OH 45212 _Warren County Board of Elections_ - 520 Justice Dr, Lebanon, OH 45036For more information on hours for voting, click [here](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjjilyid-kujkulhluu-i/)! Click [here](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjjilyid-kujkulhluu-d/) for an absentee request form - the deadline to request an absentee ballot is rapidly approaching. **_This Week 's Blog - "6 Days"_**With less than two weeks until the Election, this week's blog is about what's at stake in the closing days of this election:_" Okay, back to the most consequential midterm election in a long, long time. Please, please, please - vote! And if you have friends and family members who love this country, and want to get us back on the right track, make sure they vote too.__Because this is our chance. This is our opportunity. To make us once again, as Ronald Reagan famously said, "that shining city upon a hill."_Read the blog post [here](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjjilyid-kujkulhluu-h/). We're in the final days of the Election. Make sure you have a plan to vote and make sure your friends and family do as well. Every vote counts and every vote matters. Let's win this.Have a great weekend.Yours truly,John GomezCampaign Manager - Chabot for Congress [Donate](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjjilyid-kujkulhluu-k/) [Get a Yard Sign](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjjilyid-kujkulhluu-u/) [](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjjilyid-kujkulhluu-o/) [](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjjilyid-kujkulhluu-b/)[](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjjilyid-kujkulhluu-n/)[](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjjilyid-kujkulhluu-p/) [ Share ](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-fb-tjjilyid-kujkulhluu-v/) [ Tweet ](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-tw-tjjilyid-kujkulhluu-e/) [ Forward ](https://stevechabotforcongress.forwardtomyfriend.com/r-kujkulhluu-961825B2-tjjilyid-l-s) | Chabot for Congress, P.O. Box 54461, Cincinnati, OH 45254 You are receiving this email because of your connection to our cause. If you receive this email in error, please use the unsubscribe link below and remove yourself from future mailings. I’m reaching out about the most important Senate race in the country, which could decide whether Democrats hold onto and strengthen our majority: My friend Catherine Cortez Masto’s race in Nevada.
Catherine knows a thing or two about making cracks in glass ceilings. Back in 2016, Republicans spent $50 million trying to defeat her. Pundits and pollsters counted Catherine out, predicting Nevada would flip red. But she fought her heart out and overcame it all, becoming our nation’s first and only Latina senator.
History has a way of repeating itself: Catherine once again is facing Republican attacks that media reports have called “unprecedented” – with Mitch McConnell and his allies spending more than **$55 million** to defeat her. Election experts at several major media outlets – _The New York Times_ , _CNN_ , Nate Silver’s _FiveThirtyEight_ – have called Catherine the most vulnerable senator on the ballot. **Experts are saying Nevada is Mitch McConnell’s best hope at flipping a seat red, and he only needs to pick up one seat to take back control of the Senate.**
I’m asking you not to let that happen. Catherine needs your grassroots support in these crucial, final days of the election.

Across the country, we are seeing a wave of extremist Republican candidates – handpicked and backed by Donald Trump – running to flip the Senate red. Nevada is no exception. Catherine is up against an opponent who _led_ Donald Trump’s efforts to overturn the election results in Nevada. Her opponent also celebrated the overturning of _Roe_ , calling the landmark law that protected reproductive freedom “a joke.”
So, friend, this election is not merely a choice between divergent political parties. It’s a choice of whether we stand with candidates like Catherine on the side of truth, progress and democracy – or whether we allow candidates loyal to Donald Trump take power and trample all over our democracy.

Hillary Clinton

subject: 9 Felonies for Exposing Planned Parenthood
body:
I'm writing this letter to you today because, quite frankly, David Daleiden cannot.
[View this message in your browser](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z7dtanpek274ola3h99rj51ipgmi6sh2kicum068_rp22sh2s8i66or7cdimcor7chh238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuij78bielqr0sbiegqb7ctl6tr779hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4onjmppm0tpkctim9cdlcdrj0spgs5pj8tb1cdrjapbks5pr0or26apbdc5hcdieeduie1p64pjgm9j71p5jcdjr4tr664qbbdhnm9rmcc5gm9j61o5lcdge1d9h66qj3dbi4no)
Dear Friend, I'm writing this letter to you today because, quite frankly, David Daleiden cannot. You may remember David as the undercover journalist who spent 30 months investigating and capturing video evidence of Planned Parenthood 's top leadership --- medical directors, national program directors, even its Senior Director of Medical Services -- **callously negotiating the harvesting and sale of aborted baby body parts.** **And now, he’s been charged with nine bogus felonies.** **[Which is why I’m asking you to make an emergency donation to the DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND right away.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zfj1bilb8kkbphse3lhres0b4pm7nangh9sgrh8g_rp22sh2s8i66or7cdimcor7chh2bs)** You see, after David released the shocking videos of the illegal and disgusting actions of abortion executives, Kamala Harris, then California's Attorney General, colluded with Planned Parenthood to file felony charges against David... _**... Kamala Harris even ordered the California Department of Justice to raid David's home and confiscate his unpublished videos.**_ I won't sugarcoat it. If not cleared of these charges, David faces steep fines and years in state penitentiary and the consequences of being a convicted felon. While Kamala Harris --- a bought-and-paid-for ally of the abortion industry --- is sitting one heartbeat away from the presidency. That's the bad news. But here's the good news... David is fighting back. In fact, he's taking another opportunity to drag more of Planned Parenthood's dark criminality into the spotlight with two new federal lawsuits. That's right. The Thomas More Society has filed a federal civil rights lawsuit in California on behalf of David against former California Attorney General and now VicePresident Kamala Harris for prosecuting David in bad faith, twisting and perverting California's anti-eavesdropping law to persecute a citizen journalist because of his political views. Then the Thomas More Society filed a defamation (libel) lawsuit in federal court in New York against Planned Parenthood, which said David created a "fake" and "false" "smear campaign" against Planned Parenthood. In other words, the best defense is a good offense. The truth is we could no longer let David suffer such a trampling of his free speech and due process rights without a counterattack. The timing couldn't be more important. This is a critical opportunity to put Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the rest of the abortion industry on trial for conspiring to silence David in order to cover-up their illegal activities. **[That's where your emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND comes in --- by giving today you can stand with David in his hour of need.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zcm1mm4ocgoehmpk3rrk1b3q0im2h9mdt9vcqqtg_rp22sh2s8i66or7cdimcor7chh2bs)** The reality is. . . You couldn't be there when David entered the dark underbelly of the abortion industry --- sitting across the table from abortionists haggling over the price of baby body parts with cold-blooded clarity... "I want a Lamborghini." You couldn't be there as David saw with his own eyes the preborn children who had been killed with great precision and delicacy to preserve their organs for maximum profit. You couldn't be there when the videos were released and Kamala Harris and Planned Parenthood conspired to crush David with trumped up legal charges and an armed raid on his home in which they seized laptops, hard-drives, and recording equipment. And you couldn't be there with David (our criminal defense team was there) when he voluntarily appeared in both Texas and California for booking and processing --- fingerprinted and photographed for a mugshot like a common criminal. But, now, this is the reality... there is something you can do. **[You can make an emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND to help vindicate this pro-life hero.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zpjo0s65q0iq6gb25mna2hs8vkanoon6t9upl4u0_rp22sh2s8i66or7cdimcor7chh2bs)** My name is Tom Brejcha. I'm the president and chief counsel of the Thomas More Society --- a not-for-profit law firm underwriting and helping to spearhead David's criminal defense. The Thomas More Society is proud to have defended many renowned pro-life and religious leaders in America's pro-life movement such as Joe, Ann, and Eric Scheidler, the Pro-Life Action League, Shawn Carney and 40 Days for Life, Abby Johnson, the Susan B. Anthony List, David Bereit, Lila Rose and Live Action, Students for Life, Sidewalk Advocates for Life, Created Equal, former Kansas Attorney General Phill Kline, the March for Life, and many more. Because when dark forces like Planned Parenthood unleash their full might to legally, financially, and personally destroy our clients --- **we fight back.** I have to tell you, despite all that David is facing, his spirits remain high. Of course, I've never known anyone in this kind of position who didn't feel an empty pit in his stomach. But David's not giving up. His willingness to fight back is a true profile in Pro-Life courage. Now I'll get right down to it... **We anticipate David's legal defense will cost us more than $6 million. That's right, SIX MILLION DOLLARS.** In addition to the criminal case and the new federal civil rights and defamation lawsuits, we're currently representing David in THREE other cases.
* The civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood where we are appealing the jury's verdict, along with the judge's order permanently banning David from doing any more undercover journalism against Planned Parenthood. Recently, we posted a $700,000 appeal bond to keep Planned Parenthood’s nasty collection agents from harassing him with collection agents and even seizing his belongings. We’re fighting back, but we’ll need your help.

* The civil lawsuit brought by the National Abortion Federation and the "gag order" injunction that still prohibits David from releasing any more of his video evidence exposing Planned Parenthood's illegal fetal tissue business. name: Office of U.S. Senator Raphael Warnock
subject: Serving All Georgians, in Every Corner of the State
body:
|
---
Hi Neighbor, When I was a kid growing up in Savannah, I never dreamed that one day I would have the honor of serving as a United States Senator for my home state. Representing our state has been the honor of my life, and as a voice for Georgia in the Senate, _I 'm laser-focused on delivering for all Georgians, in every corner of our state. _ **BRINGING JOBS TO THE PEACH STATE** One of my main priorities has been working to help __all__ Georgians grow and thrive. That's why I've worked tirelessly to bring good-paying jobs to our state.
* I worked closely with Hyundai to bring a new manufacturing factory to Bryan County, bringing **8,100 new jobs** to Coastal Georgia.

* I fought for a federal grant that paved the way for **600 jobs** at a new battery component facility coming to Augusta.

* I secured policies and investments that will create **470 more jobs** at the QCells plant in Dalton.

* And, I stepped in to save over**2,600 jobs** at the SK Innovation electric battery plant in Commerce after working with the companies involved to help them settle a legal dispute and keep the plant online.

**INVESTING IN GEORGIA 'S INFRASTRUCTURE ** I've long said Georgia needs a home improvement project. That's why I helped pass the Bipartisan Infrastructure law, which is already improving our state's infrastructure and supporting Georgia communities in every corner of our state.
* Thanks to the new law, 21,000 residents in Middle Georgia will benefit from investments in broadband--strengthening broadband connectivity for schools, farms, and businesses in Georgia's rural areas.

* I worked across the aisle to ensure the infrastructure law designated I-14 as a high-priority corridor, supporting military bases from the Marine Corps Logistic Base in Albany to Fort Gordon in Augusta.

* I secured funding for much-needed renovations for Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport, creating over 500 jobs and ensuring it remains the busiest airport in the world.

* The law I championed also makes the biggest investment ever in public transportation, encouraging new economic opportunities and improving mobility for Georgians all across the state as they commute to school, work, medical appointments and more.

**FIGHTING FOR GEORGIA 'S SERVICEMEMBERS & MILITARY BASES** Georgia is a military state. As the son of a veteran, and a voice in the Senate for our state's military communities, I'm focused on championing policies that benefit our servicemembers and Georgia's critical military bases. That's why I've secured major federal investments for every single one of our state's military installations, and I'm constantly working to ensure each base community maintains key missions that will keep them thriving for years to come.
* I pushed Air Force leadership to ensure four __new__ missions for Robins Air Force Base, and I brought the chair of the Senate Armed Services Committee down to Robins to see firsthand the important role this base plays in our national security.

* I successfully fought President Biden to keep Savannah's Combat Readiness Training Center fully-funded and open.

* I secured a commitment from the Army to address the deteriorating stormwater system at Fort Benning. Additionally, I secured $62 million to construct a much-needed Special Operations Forces battalion headquarters at the base.

* I held a roundtable with Kings Bay Naval Submarine Base about challenges facing the submarine base community and secured $19.3 million for critical electrical transmission and distribution.

* And, in the most recent draft government funding bill, I secured $6.4 million for Albany Marine Corps Logistics Base to improve the base's consolidated command center.

I'm proud of what I've been able to deliver so far for Georgians-from the jobs and investments listed above, to capping insulin costs for Medicare patients, lowering prescription drug costs for seniors, and more. From Georgia's smallest county to its largest, from our most populous to some of our most rural, _know that I will never stop fighting to ensure Georgians in all 159 counties have the resources they need to thrive in our great state._ Until next time, neighbors--keep the faith, and keep looking up.
U.S. Senator Reverend Raphael Warnock

body:
Voters in Pennsylvania have made the right choice every time they’ve elected Josh

| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zin212frc6nn1vonhg1s5tak4vdvif29bvoao648_rp22sh2s8i66or7cdim6o74cph2bs "Johnson1")**_

Please, Friend, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in. I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled. The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem. This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign. I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs. Hi team - it’s Eric Holder. I’ll get straight to the point: our democracy is on the ballot next week.

Across the nation, Republicans who denied the results of the last election are vying to become Secretary of State so they can influence the results of the next one.

If any of these election deniers win, they’ll be the top election official who will oversee election laws and make decisions about when, where, and how folks vote. They could even decide if they would certify (or not) the results of the 2024 election in their state.

It’s clear, team: Republicans are trying to undermine elections from the inside, with elected officials who are willing to tilt the scales in their favor – or even throw out the results of free and fair elections.

We can’t let them take away our voices.... If we want to defend our democracy, we must preserve access to the ballot box and defeat anti-democracy candidates.

My friends at The Democratic Association of Secretaries of State (DASS) are leading the effort to elect candidates who will follow the rule of law, expand voting rights, and protect our democracy - but with Election Day fast approaching, we need your help more than ever.

That’s why I’m asking you to make a donation of any amount to DASS so we can defend our democracy and the sacred right to vote. Please, chip in anything you can now >>

body:
Before I ask you for that donation, I want to take a step back and explain why I'm in this race.
| | |
---
Peter, the last few weeks have been a whirlwind, to say the least. But now, just three days before the election, it's somehow even busier, even more intense, and even higher stakes. [**But to keep our campaign firing on all cylinders as we head into this final stretch,**** I'm counting on your donation tonight****.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54104648/377447725/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk429-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNTIzZjczNi0xYjVkLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=tgiu5k34-lMmHLUhxqLgwAV3pjJbB5XAWfV7eq8yc9Y=)** Strong grassroots support is the only way we'll be able to go toe to toe with Eric Schmitt's megadonors on Election Day.**
But before I ask you for that donation, I want to take a step back and explain why I'm in this race. You see, I've spent my whole life in Missouri. As a young girl growing up here, my parents taught me that “to whom much is given, much is required.” **That sense of duty to help others is what drove me to choose a life of service.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54104649/377447726/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk429-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNTIzZjczNi0xYjVkLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=tgiu5k34-lMmHLUhxqLgwAV3pjJbB5XAWfV7eq8yc9Y=)
When I was a kid, I dreamed of becoming a nurse. To me, nurses were the real superheroes. They took care of people and saved lives. That’s what I wanted to do – so I made it happen.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54104650/377447727/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk429-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNTIzZjczNi0xYjVkLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=tgiu5k34-lMmHLUhxqLgwAV3pjJbB5XAWfV7eq8yc9Y=)
Right after nursing school, I worked at a hospital and cared for children, seniors, people who relied on Medicare and Medicaid for their healthcare, and folks from all walks of life. Later on in my career, I volunteered to care for patients in hospice and comfort their families. And when the pandemic hit, I signed up to help administer some of the first COVID-19 vaccines.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54104651/377447728/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk429-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNTIzZjczNi0xYjVkLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=tgiu5k34-lMmHLUhxqLgwAV3pjJbB5XAWfV7eq8yc9Y=)
**Throughout these experiences, I've seen the importance of quality healthcare firsthand.** As a nurse, I believe that every person deserves access to quality and affordable medical care, and as a parent, I believe that everyone should have access to contraception and abortion care – full stop.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54104652/377447729/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk429-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNTIzZjczNi0xYjVkLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=tgiu5k34-lMmHLUhxqLgwAV3pjJbB5XAWfV7eq8yc9Y=)
**I’ve spent my life giving back and helping others, and now I’m running for U.S. Senate because we need a nurse's heart in Washington.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54104653/377447730/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk429-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNTIzZjczNi0xYjVkLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=tgiu5k34-lMmHLUhxqLgwAV3pjJbB5XAWfV7eq8yc9Y=)
If I could go back to any of the younger versions of myself in these photos, she wouldn't believe it if I told her we would one day be on the cusp of taking our heart of service all the way to the U.S. Senate. **I hope I am making her, everyone in these photos, and – most importantly – you proud.**
Running a campaign with stakes this high is scary, for sure. Still, I'd be lying if I said I wasn't excited. **I know that on Election Day (which is just THREE days away!), we're going to prove to everyone that hope, compassion, and people-first politics _can_ win. **But I need your help to do that, and right now, we're falling $3,455 short of our next midnight grassroots goal.
**We cannot afford to fall short of our fundraising goals this close to an election, so I have to ask you: **[Please, can you make a donation of $5, or whatever you can spare tonight, to power this campaign through the final stretch and help me bring compassion, honesty, and respect back to Washington?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54104654/377447731/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk429-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNTIzZjczNi0xYjVkLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=tgiu5k34-lMmHLUhxqLgwAV3pjJbB5XAWfV7eq8yc9Y=)
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | | [DONATE $5](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54104655/377447732/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&express_lane=true&amount=5&refcode=jtk429-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNTIzZjczNi0xYjVkLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=tgiu5k34-lMmHLUhxqLgwAV3pjJbB5XAWfV7eq8yc9Y=)
---
| | [DONATE $25](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54104656/377447733/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&express_lane=true&amount=25&refcode=jtk429-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNTIzZjczNi0xYjVkLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=tgiu5k34-lMmHLUhxqLgwAV3pjJbB5XAWfV7eq8yc9Y=)

**_[In order to win my race and flip New Hampshire RED, I need every person reading this to pitch in a donation of any amount in the next 30 minutes.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zonvfhoqrpvhdqt03unku5qa80erl530o85tk9j8_rp22sh2s8i66or7cdhm0pb0cdh2bs "In order to win my race and flip New Hampshire RED, I need every person reading this to pitch in a donation of any amount in the next 30 minutes.")_**

Team —
At this point, most people would say we're 2 days from Election Day. But in the Navy, especially on deployments, you counted the days a little differently. The way we'd look at it, your last day wasn't really a full day. It's the day you woke up and got to go home, so it didn't really count. Thinking about it like that made things just a little bit easier .
So for me, it's 2 days and a wake up. 2 days and an election.
Now, I don't pay much attention to polls. But a new one just showed me down by one point against Blake Masters. That’s all it takes to win, and with MAGA Inc and other Super PACs with wacky names dropping millions to flip this seat — with just 2 days and a wake up to go — I really need your help.
That's why I'm asking you to put in your $20 to fight back -- to split a donation between me and Seth Moulton. If you can give more, it's really appreciated. But if that's all you can do, I'm grateful for it. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-kelly?refcode=221105_MK_split]
Thank you. And remember: We're almost there.

clean_body: [] Team — At this point, most people would say we're 2 days from Election Day. But in the Navy, especially on deployments, you counted the days a little differently. The way we'd look at it, your last day wasn't really a full day. It's the day you woke up and got to go home, so it didn't really count. Thinking about it like that made things just a little bit easier . So for me, it's 2 days and a wake up. 2 days and an election. Now, I don't pay much attention to polls. But a new one just showed me down by one point against Blake Masters. That’s all it takes to win, and with MAGA Inc and other Super PACs with wacky names dropping millions to flip this seat — with just 2 days and a wake up to go — I really need your help. That's why I'm asking you to put in your $20 to fight back -- to split a donation between me and Seth Moulton. If you can give more, it's really appreciated. But if that's all you can do, I'm grateful for it. [] Thank you. And remember: We're almost there. body:
Peter,
We’re just a few days away from Election Day! Have you voted yet?
If you haven’t cast your ballot, be sure to have a plan to vote this Tuesday. Polls are open from 7am until 8pm. Unlike with early voting, you must vote at the polling place to which you are assigned. Click here to look up information about where to vote. [https://voterservices.elections.maryland.gov/votersearch]
If you have a mail-in ballot that hasn’t been returned, be sure to mail it or put it in a drop box by Tuesday. Remember, your ballot must be postmarked by Tuesday in order to be counted. Click here for a list of ballot drop boxes near you. [https://elections.maryland.gov/voting/documents/2022_GG_DropBoxLocations_English.pdf]
If you’ve already voted, thank you for making your voice heard! There is still more to be done before Election Day. Here are three ways you can help out before the polls close:
*
Talk
to
5
friends
or
family
members
and
make
sure
they
have
a
plan
to
vote.
*
Volunteer
with
my
campaign.
We
will
have
volunteers
at
polling
locations
across
the
district,
and
will
be
knocking
doors
all
weekend.
Click
here
to
sign
up.
[https://www.mobilize.us/davidtrone/]
*
Post
on
social
media
and
let
your
friends
know
that
you
voted!
Please
tag
me
in
any
fun
pictures
so
that
my
team
can
share
them!
We’re so close to the finish line, and I’m confident that we’ll win — but it will take all of us. Thank you for your support!
Sincerely,
David

* Cost of living has skyrocketed
* Gas has skyrocketed
* Crime has skyrocketed

The list goes on and on.

That’s why my campaign has focused on solutions to solving these problems.

If you know people who are still on the fence, undecided whether they’ll vote, or unsure of who I am, can you send them this link?

Please - [forward this message to as many people as you can and encourage them to vote!](https://us14.forward-to-friend.com/forward?u=11c7ad6aa59a7d39fc5819cc1&id=49ba056a41&e=f9133ea432)

We are just 3 days away from making history in California.

\- Senator Brian Dahle

body:
Hi friend,
I’m reaching out about the most important Senate race in the country, which could decide whether Democrats hold onto and strengthen our majority: my friend Catherine Cortez Masto’s race in Nevada.
Catherine knows a thing or two about making cracks in glass ceilings. Back in 2016, Republicans spent $50 million trying to defeat her. Pundits and pollsters counted Catherine out, predicting Nevada would flip red. But she fought her heart out and overcame it all, becoming our nation’s first and only Latina senator.
History has a way of repeating itself: Catherine once again is facing Republican attacks that media reports have called “unprecedented” – with Mitch McConnell and his allies spending more than $55 million to defeat her. Every major election forecaster – The New York Times , CNN, Nate Silver’s FiveThirtyEight – has called Catherine the most vulnerable senator on the ballot. Experts are saying Nevada is Mitch McConnell’s best hope at flipping a seat red, and he only needs to pick up one seat to take back control of the Senate.
I'm asking you to not let that happen. Catherine needs your grassroots support in these crucial, final days of the election. Will you split a donation of
Across the country, we are seeing a wave of extremist Republican candidates – handpicked and backed by Donald Trump – running to flip the Senate red. Nevada is no exception. Catherine is up against an opponent who led Donald Trump’s efforts to overturn the election results in Nevada. Her opponent also celebrated the overturning of Roe, calling the landmark law that protected reproductive freedom “a joke.”
So, friend, this election is not merely a choice between divergent political parties. It’s a choice of whether we stand with candidates like Catherine on the side of truth, progress and democracy – or whether we allow candidates loyal to Donald Trump take power and trample all over our democracy.
The choice is ours to make, but time is running short. With just five days to go, polling shows Catherine in a statistical tie with her opponent, so she urgently needs grassroots resources to mobilize voters, pull ahead and win. So please, split a contribution of
Thank you,
Hillary Clinton

Take a look: = From now until the polls close on Tuesday, we're making calls, knocking on doors, and running ads to share what's at stake and why we can't afford to have my Trump-supporting opponent in Congress. This race is still neck-and-neck, so every conversation gets us one step closer to keeping this seat blue. But I'll be honest: reaching voters isn't easy – or cheap. That's why we need your support to reach our final goal of this election, our Get Out the Vote Fund goal, to ensure we can continue getting out the vote and win this "toss-up" race. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | = | = | = | = | = | = Thank you, Seth Rhode Island Treasurer Seth Magaziner is running for Congress in Rhode Island's competitive open Second District – and election experts are calling this race a "toss up." subject: feeling optimistic

body:
| Good morning, Peter. I hope you’re having a great weekend so far. I, for one, am feeling very optimistic and thankful this morning. That’s because in a couple of hours Team Sorensen staff and volunteers will be out knocking on doors and calling voters across the 17th District to get out the vote. I look forward to joining them shortly! Throughout this campaign, my team and I have been blown away by the grassroots support we’ve seen from Illinoisans of all stripes. From the bottom of my heart, Peter, I want to thank you for pushing us this far. Now it’s time to turn out as many voters as we can – and we’re turning to supporters like you for help once again. It’s not too late to boost our Get Out The Vote push between now and Election Day. Here’s a good link to chip in to support our staff and volunteers in these final 72 hours: [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/es-q4-2022](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zSJ2-Su0o8Ni7LeDh2MrPPUvpXBRo6wFsFkfdA82RDzCqnhq2tELimcN_MP82GlKw2bM2IVuxIlHEDIRBZMdG89mOoL5SJDTMiicfnWLogpuwHuta-8RdvfPwBO0j_z8ATlVv18xowm-cK-dFDQXPab4N0Z0lAjrhoHm7n6XvXWSdp_zk1Xs_qwwY-TupXL77OmhrcdQe7lxYfphSK9E05HGp8CUtJ8sLIqbbQZB8vXJMd5z9R69VE-jxZzkT-jBB0wcrr4ayYg1hmBKxluTPbyJsXszvmpelTzbTj7_dozQ/3qw/bjp0ACIwQiGUCcr0t2jpvA/h0/XqNkbyF2GmuzDr157CbhuoXu0kw5ENNQDqJ_RW1bVEQ) With each passing day, voters are beginning to realize what’s at stake for our community in this race. I was born and raised in this district, and I will always stand up for the people of IL-17 if elected to Congress. I’ll fight for lower healthcare costs, reproductive freedom, and the safety of our communities. My far-right opponent is more interested in padding her political resume than she is in those important issues. Hey there, Matt here, Dr. Kermit’s finance director. Since your grassroots donations are funding this campaign, we think you deserve to know how we’re using your dollars. Here’s what we’ve spent the most on this month:
* **Staff:** we have organizers in every corner of our 630-mile-long launching volunteer events daily. We’re running the strongest ground game in the state thanks to your support.
* **Volunteer supplies:** we have over 1,000 volunteers knocking doors to get out the vote, and we constantly have to order more fliers, pens, clipboards, and yard signs.
* **Advertising:** we’re on TV, digital, and in mailboxes, trying to reach voters wherever they are.

We’re running neck-and-neck with our opponent, but we weren’t expecting a conservative SuperPAC to start running attack ads against us on broadcast. It’s clear they’re worried we can flip this seat blue. Unfortunately, we aren’t on broadcast, which means they may be reaching voters that we aren’t. **[We have budgeted so precisely that we don’t have any extra to spend right now — we’re going to have to increase our budget TODAY. **Listen to one of Mississippi’s leading rappers, Topher, explain how he became a conservative. **
---
| [ ](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=4d1bc126e2&e=5703353baa "Topher talks Black Lives Matter")
---
_Mississippi Rapper and TikTok Influencer Topher sits down with Douglas Carswell to discuss the American Dream and conservative politics in the United States._
| **Many young Americans are invited to think of themselves as victims. **That’s nonsense says Topher.

Topher, who lives in Montgomery County and has millions of viewers on TikTok, explains why he believes America is a land of opportunity for people of every race and background.

**Topher shared his concerns about the Black Lives Matter movement.** Where, we discussed, is their outrage over the high homicide rate in Jackson, Mississippi?

**Topher’s message to young Mississippians is simple; follow these 3 rules to avoid poverty: **
**1\. Finish high school.**
**2\. Wait until you are married to have kids – preferably after you are 21.**
**3\. Have a job – any job.**
Citing research he had come across from the Brookings Institute, Topher suggests that anyone that does those three things is likely to lead a prosperous, fulfilling life – irrespective of race.

**Topher is proud of America, and proud to have served his country in the military.** It was while in the military, he explains, that he came to appreciate what it means to be an American.

I hope you will take a few moments to listen to our chat.

We need to be prepared to fight whatever they say about us. **[Will you click here to help?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54089851/377389912/-137966981?amount=15&source=em_nbi_aa_20221105_fr_1.4_0_6mo_website_na_na_gotv&refcode2=&contactdata=zVzyY3jNLFFFrUGjv0tpy3/LHTFkj1r88lDiLM6gyMLbVSHLbfql88PTjAaaXxPx&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzk0MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlN2VjNzlhYy0wNzVkLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Ozoioyqp-8UdXWMX7AzXGrOq9LQMpKZU7HLQ3wyujkM=)**

From her first ad, which didn’t even mention our district once, to her attack against trans kids and doctors which sparked violence against both groups, to her most recent ads that talk about the border over 1,300 miles away and accused me of more random things I have no part in and do not believe.

| Without hesitation, I endorse fellow veteran and patriot Delegate John McGuire for Virginia State Senate District 10 in 2023. John is a pro-life Christian Conservative, supports free market policies, has a solid conservative voting record in the General Assembly (100 Family Foundation and 100 VCDL score), and he has an unmatched work ethic. John will always fight to defend freedom and our God-given rights. Please join me in my support of John McGuire for Virginia State Senate District 10 in 2023!
-Phil Rapp US Army Airborne Ranger Infantry Officer Chief of Staff, Senior Advisor and Campaign Manager for Congressman Dave Brat from 2014 to 2018
---
| Change your clocks back on Sunday. Then change our country back on Tuesday. Our country is hanging by a string. To win, it is vital fellow Republicans put petty differences aside and unite. On Tuesday we must get Bob Good, Yesli Vega, and the rest of our congressional delegation across the finish line. Please remind friends to vote!
Redistricting back in December threw many of us for a loop. My team and I considered and discussed many options on how I could continue the fight to protect our God given rights. After much prayer and thought it became clear to my wife Tracy and I the new Senate District 10 open seat was the best way for me to continue the teamwork and fight needed to save our country from radical marxist policies and continue to advance our conservative values in the commonwealth. It is an honor to receive the endorsement from fellow veteran and patriot Phil Rapp. I am fired up, full of energy, and ready to continue fighting for you in State Senate District 10. This election, TBD, will most likely be in the spring of 2023.
---

Peter,

We are just THREE DAYS away from the most consequential election in our state’s history. In 2018, Florida was just a hair away from a very different fate.

A few thousand votes made the difference between the free Florida you and I know today and a Florida that would’ve mimicked the tyrannical lockdowns and lunacy we saw in states like New York and California.

Every vote matters, Peter.

As Early Voting is coming to a close in counties across the state, I’m asking you to take one action today that will dictate the future of Florida for generations to come.

I am counting on YOUR VOTE to Keep Florida Free.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=c6c338b4cdbc89566ca12da49b1166b8ebd974f54957076363f829c17e34b5bcf3caecfa535f2d919a1c68edbb8db03bb7d9e8ef41e35100036225bcd50a1bce

This election is about more than just claiming a victory for Republicans, Peter. This is about preserving our liberties and our freedoms.

Every ballot not cast is an automatic vote for my opponent, Biden’s Pocket puppet, who will be just another cog in the wheel for the Democrat Machine.

We cannot afford to hand this election over to another member for the Biden Regime who will attempt to indoctrinate our children and exert unchecked control over every aspect of our lives.

Get out and vote to ensure the Left does not turn our state into the once-free state of Florida.

It will take all of us to bring home this victory, and we don’t want to look back and wish we had done more.

Thank you for standing with me in this fight, Peter. Help us finish strong by going out to vote for a FREE Florida!

For Florida,
Ron DeSantis
