| Peter,
The Ammon Bundy for Governor Team Leaders have decided to fast and pray this _Sunday, November 6th_ to ask our Heavenly Father for his blessings on election day, specifically. We want to ask for His favor to be upon those whose hearts are pure, that they will understand freedom and liberty and that their vote for Ammon will help us preserve those blessings afforded us by Him, God, our Heavenly Father. We invite all who are able and willing to join us in fasting and praying that the voting process will be secure, that any attempts at cheating will be thwarted, and the outcome will be God's will.
In [Matthew 17:15-21](https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Matthew-Chapter-17/) of the New Testament we read:

_15_ "Lord, have mercy on my son: for he is lunatic, and sore vexed: for ofttimes he falleth into the fire, and oft into the water.

_16_ And I brought him to thy disciples, and they could not cure him.

_17_ Then Jesus answered and said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him hither to me.

_18_ And Jesus rebuked the devil; and he departed out of him: and the child was cured from that very hour.

_19_ Then came the disciples to Jesus apart, and said, Why could not we cast him out?

_20_ And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.

_21_ Howbeit this kind goeth not out but by prayer and fasting."
Jesus first says, "O wicked and perverse generation"; are we not witnessing wickedness and perverseness now, in our day? He goes on to explain to His disciples that they couldn't cast out the devil because of their own unbelief and that they need to use fasting and prayer to gain faith and the power to cast out devils. "Howbeit this kind goeth not out but by prayer and fasting." [Matthew 17:21](https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Matthew-17-21/)

Where Jesus taught prayer and fasting to his disciples, we in the Bundy Campaign believe these are still important principles in our day. The wickedness we see in Idaho today needs our faith, our fasting, and our prayers to be "cast out".

Thank you and may God bless you all and heal our great state and the people of Idaho!

**Ammon Bundy for Governor Team Leaders**

We HOPE it will not be our last chance to advance gun safety legislation for the next two years... but if it is, we have to be ready.
#

Friends -
Tuesday is Election Day.
At Giffords, we’re extremely proud of the work we’ve done to impact a number of key federal and local races this election cycle that will shape the future of the gun safety debate--from running ads to turning out voters.
But we have to also be prepared for the days after Election Day.

One of those businesses was in the field of technology, where I built a company that created an advanced piece of software that is now considered to be the gold standard in its industry to this day.Many know that additionally, I have worked tirelessly, with friends and family to support individuals in their need for support when they were likewise being terrorized by corrupt government officials or otherwise had their rights threatened or violated.Ultimately, I built the People's Rights Network, again from scratch, which is a network of likeminded Americans who have pledged to support their neighbors and defend them if and when their rights are being violated. The Network spans the entire country and has nearly 65,000 members.So while I don't care to talk about it or "toot my own horn," _the fact of the matter is that I have plenty of experience with leadership, business, and technology that will server the People of Idaho well when I am in the governors office._ But if you believe what the media says, Ammon Bundy is just some dumb "hick from the styx" who shoots guns and wears a tin foil hat. body:
| |
---
| | | Friend,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I decided to run for U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b5f4c9b94b0d40219c93c8489d653f36&_e=WzIG1S66m7lrjK944RHltpzR5-2x66XvqpzLJ1RfoT1Vr-dJhGtvuZWbjGT_HAHHqqU6HnH3p8MlSHHHiXQDEuottPNO_YHXN16_RcV-mC8YH39iXL_AVgXtdNl-rkTBVw2SflL7EJ1Ww6q5mTVdwUBJlRYHMjj5Qf_zKCBnSM1jMWEmib35eOJVDccmY9Ae2cBfpdYXb7pqnFJKAP1lTOC9cxdPrLduVS9tLiLkt1oviS-ebAytULTvVj0OZV0ro7cYIYWhhdvO2N-PwyRdbdkB1XuG5WkjWAaKkzv5ayjY03Y9Cc3anVYNkvJ1XFu6Zr4LG-f1XwspOfM5NH3yaK2wL4uuDgNpS-z3qAALtp0SnH5xJkvvY_gW3kJFmdRjr1MS2UI4w19gsAEsSa8rkT6M2LMalf88DKaSpwaEhmnWEu0rO0fT_whRlMQigtuY "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b5f4c9b94b0d40219c93c8489d653f36&_e=WzIG1S66m7lrjK944RHltpzR5-2x66XvqpzLJ1RfoT1Vr-dJhGtvuZWbjGT_HAHHqqU6HnH3p8MlSHHHiXQDEuottPNO_YHXN16_RcV-mC8YH39iXL_AVgXtdNl-rkTBVw2SflL7EJ1Ww6q5mTVdwUBJlRYHMjj5Qf_zKCBnSM1jMWEmib35eOJVDccmY9Ae2cBfpdYXb7pqnFJKAP1lTOC9cxdPrLduVS9tLiLkt1oviS-ebAytULTvVj0OZV0ro7cYIYWhhdvO2N-PwyRdbdkB1XuG5WkjWAaKkzv5ayjt874qftl7U0f3yHnp8qWZzNZtuE1z9gs6lVXfczlvROPMJMAIAe2DMPsO7du8peW7dxNpoixGyyaZSOj1G-kU5VqzuTxrHbDw4jnvXc2VGOCVcQ2Gjv7Xr_ZYscCYHiAUHtkKLkvUOcYQ9jUvX4Ug "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b5f4c9b94b0d40219c93c8489d653f36&_e=WzIG1S66m7lrjK944RHltpzR5-2x66XvqpzLJ1RfoT1Vr-dJhGtvuZWbjGT_HAHHqqU6HnH3p8MlSHHHiXQDEuottPNO_YHXN16_RcV-mC8YH39iXL_AVgXtdNl-rkTBVw2SflL7EJ1Ww6q5mTVdwUBJlRYHMjj5Qf_zKCBnSM1jMWEmib35eOJVDccmY9Ae2cBfpdYXb7pqnFJKAP1lTOC9cxdPrLduVS9tLiLkt1oviS-ebAytULTvVj0OZV0ro7cYIYWhhdvO2N-PwyRdbdkB1XuG5WkjWAaKkzv5ayiPmgVHKFw28J3lq1ExZ4aal5XS5WUjCv4_RqOS0zsiKlm9Eh8BouJEQVPgM8r3rt1slR2JM3YsmXeY0e2JciIryiZI9yRGva5Hi5K9OFO_3NuuPvsHfUTFIHK0Pz10F1bHW8aPIZ7pLzwXVeQ8_w43 "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b5f4c9b94b0d40219c93c8489d653f36&_e=WzIG1S66m7lrjK944RHltpzR5-2x66XvqpzLJ1RfoT1Vr-dJhGtvuZWbjGT_HAHHqqU6HnH3p8MlSHHHiXQDEuottPNO_YHXN16_RcV-mC8YH39iXL_AVgXtdNl-rkTBVw2SflL7EJ1Ww6q5mTVdwUBJlRYHMjj5Qf_zKCBnSM1jMWEmib35eOJVDccmY9Ae2cBfpdYXb7pqnFJKAP1lTOC9cxdPrLduVS9tLiLkt1oviS-ebAytULTvVj0OZV0ro7cYIYWhhdvO2N-PwyRdbdkB1XuG5WkjWAaKkzv5aygYYuog7ghT0FOYDIwxdBHNMxlZ__fkTQe4OUhd4h8PBGHjbwDCubMfgIGZMEMoceb1nslQjlWNL5W94R6D9vgmXLP0eDw3UFTV-DuogFAqkzocSdxPsn6IiZbicXYuX5yYJ9FGFkZCrSGe7uMRxaGJ "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b5f4c9b94b0d40219c93c8489d653f36&_e=WzIG1S66m7lrjK944RHltpzR5-2x66XvqpzLJ1RfoT1Vr-dJhGtvuZWbjGT_HAHHqqU6HnH3p8MlSHHHiXQDEuottPNO_YHXN16_RcV-mC8YH39iXL_AVgXtdNl-rkTBVw2SflL7EJ1Ww6q5mTVdwUBJlRYHMjj5Qf_zKCBnSM1jMWEmib35eOJVDccmY9Ae2cBfpdYXb7pqnFJKAP1lTOC9cxdPrLduVS9tLiLkt1oviS-ebAytULTvVj0OZV0ro7cYIYWhhdvO2N-PwyRdbdkB1XuG5WkjWAaKkzv5ayhdpIARj8IEtMXEx8DWPY46J8eRoX4-tGx0VGZVSCgbCwAc29pXOsYNk6BanvdSSegVExSRZ0IfEd8iSI7uzLeoF-v1yixAo-v-ZFtjpP-TUFF_Ja_yfbM6YpnZRO2xW34bZQGHvUW1R_kWw5wRC6nQ "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b5f4c9b94b0d40219c93c8489d653f36&_e=WzIG1S66m7lrjK944RHltpzR5-2x66XvqpzLJ1RfoT1Vr-dJhGtvuZWbjGT_HAHHqqU6HnH3p8MlSHHHiXQDEuottPNO_YHXN16_RcV-mC8YH39iXL_AVgXtdNl-rkTBVw2SflL7EJ1Ww6q5mTVdwUBJlRYHMjj5Qf_zKCBnSM1jMWEmib35eOJVDccmY9Ae2cBfpdYXb7pqnFJKAP1lTOC9cxdPrLduVS9tLiLkt1oviS-ebAytULTvVj0OZV0ro7cYIYWhhdvO2N-PwyRdbdkB1XuG5WkjWAaKkzv5aygpA6BxwnlhPdlgy9ncKePaRZ4AIE87QZdkSdT0iVGfImPGGXHlEr-XGcpVUTXIAQTbOzKVrpavEAY8OXunD3hJmIbdpuOE31l08UpZrvWR3E23icTg35xu7sv7hMP-7Cf_jiCo_CYANXfjnfnYjreC "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b5f4c9b94b0d40219c93c8489d653f36&_e=WzIG1S66m7lrjK944RHltpzR5-2x66XvqpzLJ1RfoT1Vr-dJhGtvuZWbjGT_HAHHqqU6HnH3p8MlSHHHiXQDEuottPNO_YHXN16_RcV-mC8YH39iXL_AVgXtdNl-rkTBVw2SflL7EJ1Ww6q5mTVdwUBJlRYHMjj5Qf_zKCBnSM1jMWEmib35eOJVDccmY9Ae2cBfpdYXb7pqnFJKAP1lTOC9cxdPrLduVS9tLiLkt1oviS-ebAytULTvVj0OZV0ro7cYIYWhhdvO2N-PwyRdbdkB1XuG5WkjWAaKkzv5ayiKx1lwDdg3_wAZhcsGFECF17nuY4qKGygqJ67i6f80G0CDE798_bNkNZMzU7KRHzQezqtyyy6W2yFLpvBZ4dgMMciH017p6E54fK1ItuITfVxvMVrXa9QC5-LqsAbsgMuC0XCWyeOa-9fxHfG_ELzz "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b5f4c9b94b0d40219c93c8489d653f36&_e=WzIG1S66m7lrjK944RHltpzR5-2x66XvqpzLJ1RfoT1Vr-dJhGtvuZWbjGT_HAHHqqU6HnH3p8MlSHHHiXQDEuottPNO_YHXN16_RcV-mC8YH39iXL_AVgXtdNl-rkTBVw2SflL7EJ1Ww6q5mTVdwUBJlRYHMjj5Qf_zKCBnSM1jMWEmib35eOJVDccmY9Ae2cBfpdYXb7pqnFJKAP1lTOC9cxdPrLduVS9tLiLkt1oviS-ebAytULTvVj0OZV0ro7cYIYWhhdvO2N-PwyRdbdkB1XuG5WkjWAaKkzv5ayi4eQ7OkPsI8d2k9VS_AH6OMEBJ0n18SDg5F-W9lB-mC0nd6sjU1JdJspu2WEbzNBDuiBU12vCAR6ubNywveFmM81dXJLzJuRFkBn_tFsELtU2Xrb-_n9OEazVcqFrvuAVLs8T2a_qd20DQuKSnQ0wr "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family has decided to take on a new challenge. I made the choice to run for U.S. Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b5f4c9b94b0d40219c93c8489d653f36&_e=WzIG1S66m7lrjK944RHltpzR5-2x66XvqpzLJ1RfoT1Vr-dJhGtvuZWbjGT_HAHHqqU6HnH3p8MlSHHHiXQDEuottPNO_YHXN16_RcV-mC8YH39iXL_AVgXtdNl-rkTBVw2SflL7EJ1Ww6q5mTVdwUBJlRYHMjj5Qf_zKCBnSM1jMWEmib35eOJVDccmY9Ae2cBfpdYXb7pqnFJKAP1lTOC9cxdPrLduVS9tLiLkt1oviS-ebAytULTvVj0OZV0ro7cYIYWhhdvO2N-PwyRdbdkB1XuG5WkjWAaKkzv5ayheVQUoM-Hie8pFp9otlWCgOofK68CWRaKsumR4OGcx0nOyEJ_56wV4LuXtrMXPcMyE3WrsZoeBaZNJzky_JRSecvPoFubUXJKkaeAe-Yq9DHJgXfqnT1NuYr4IEkoCnC5PQMsvu7om06E7N0zgonny "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b5f4c9b94b0d40219c93c8489d653f36&_e=WzIG1S66m7lrjK944RHltpzR5-2x66XvqpzLJ1RfoT1Vr-dJhGtvuZWbjGT_HAHHqqU6HnH3p8MlSHHHiXQDEuottPNO_YHXN16_RcV-mC8YH39iXL_AVgXtdNl-rkTBVw2SflL7EJ1Ww6q5mTVdwUBJlRYHMjj5Qf_zKCBnSM1jMWEmib35eOJVDccmY9Ae2cBfpdYXb7pqnFJKAP1lTOC9cxdPrLduVS9tLiLkt1oviS-ebAytULTvVj0OZV0ro7cYIYWhhdvO2N-PwyRdbdkB1XuG5WkjWAaKkzv5ayhvx8yESMmrReT5MWbZv1MCmCmI_qb7lkOq59545t9QccoJ0GxSBJ3ZIGNT3avaFZpEgqPCJBnqxo01xejxYJC_b-Fj1W0UegKLYPa2U4pbdOxGS3nd63KU8KKSPLshEg2auCHLqqJ_eDvmEicTV5fV "So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far. clean_body: | | | | | Friend, My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I decided to run for U.S. Senate in Washington. I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work. | "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work." I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need. | "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College" I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career. | "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty" In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes. I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side. | "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq" When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army. I refused. Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned. | "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned." Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. | "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. " It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--and won. We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate. | "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate." In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys. | "In 2007, we welcomed our first child." Now, our family has decided to take on a new challenge. I made the choice to run for U.S. Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray. I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress. | "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress." My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol. I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side. We can't do that, however, without your help, friend. "So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far. " | | | "KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT" | | | "STAND UP FOR AMERICA" I know with your support we can win this. Sincerely, Tiffany Smiley | | Use of military rank, job titles, and photographs in uniform does not imply endorsement by the Department of the Army or Department of Defense. | Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc. #
Hey Derek, it’s John Fetterman with some urgent news.
**🔴 Donald Trump is coming to Latrobe, PA TONIGHT to support Dr. Oz + Doug Mastriano! 🔴**

But now, we’re only three days out from Election Day and it’s critical that we have the resources to fight back + keep reaching voters with our message before they head to the polls this Tuesday.
We don’t have a minute to waste, Derek. **So I’m asking:**
**[Will you please rush an emergency donation of any amount to my campaign before Trump touches down in PA tonight?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221105-1?refcode=em20221105-8062&refcode2=8062_434096_Bh03by&akid=8062%2E434096%2EBh03by)**

A lot of people laughed when Dr. Oz (a quack celebrity doctor who doesn’t live in PA!!!! 🙄) jumped in our race. But I’ll say now what I said then:
**The worst thing we can do is underestimate Dr. Oz.**
First, Dr. Oz is the TOP self-funding candidate in the entire country. He’s shelled out nearly $27 MILLION from his own personal fortune for his campaign for U.S. Senate.
Second, Trump could endorse a freakin’ ham sandwich for U.S. Senate and Super PACs + GOP mega-donors would still dump loads of money behind it. 🙄
Third, this huge MAGA rally just *THREE DAYS* ahead of Election Day is about to light a big fire under Trump’s base in PA — making it all that much harder for us to beat Dr. Oz next Tuesday.
Derek, I need your help to defeat this harmful celebrity doctor who has the full support of Donald Trump + virtually unlimited $$$ to spend in PA.
**[Can you PLEASE rush an emergency donation of $5 to my campaign before Trump takes the stage with Oz in PA tonight? Grassroots supporters like you are the only way we’ll be able to overpower Trump’s influence + flip this Senate seat on November 8.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221105-1?refcode=em20221105-8062&refcode2=8062_434096_Bh03by&akid=8062%2E434096%2EBh03by)**

Thank you for stepping up,
❤️ John

Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania
Democratic Nominee for U.S. Senate

name: Cecile Richards
subject: One regret
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Beto for Texas
body:
[1]Beto O'Rourke

If I have
any regret from my time leading Planned Parenthood, it’s this:

We underestimated extremists like Greg Abbott who are willing to sacrifice
women’s rights — and even threaten their lives — in exchange for their
radical anti-choice agendas.

But it isn’t too late to fight back, and nowhere is this fight more urgent than in Texas. So
before I go on, [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20221105-1.rWUtuU&refcode=ema20221105-216024&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=216024%2E444211%2EJlgsJW ]I must urge you to donate anything you can to help get
out the vote for Beto across Texas before polls close in just three days.
We must defeat Governor Abbott’s extremism at the ballot box, and elect a
leader who trusts women to make decisions about their own bodies, health
care, and futures.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20221105-1.rWUtuU&refcode=ema20221105-216024&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=216024%2E444211%2EJlgsJW ]Donate Now

I’ll admit it. Looking back on the last 20 years, I see that we didn’t
fully comprehend the lengths that extremists like Greg Abbott would go to
control women and our decisions.

Now, the most extreme abortion ban in America is in effect today across
Texas.

Greg Abbott’s dangerous law bans abortion beginning at conception. It has
no exception for rape and no exception for incest. Abbott even signed this
ban into law despite the fact that a full 82% of Texans oppose this
radical attack on reproductive freedom.

Please take a moment to read the stories of just a few of the Texas women
who have already suffered under Greg Abbott’s extremism. [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20221105-1.rWUtuU&refcode=ema20221105-216024&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=216024%2E444211%2EJlgsJW ]But if you
don’t have time to read on, please chip in now. We are running out of
hours to ensure Beto defeats Greg Abbott so we can restore reproductive
freedom to Texas women.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Outside of Houston, Ashley Brandt and her husband were thrilled to become
pregnant with twins, then tragically learned that one had a fatal birth
defect.

But under Abbott’s law, Brandt could not receive in-state abortion care to
protect the other twin, putting the delivery of a healthy baby — and the
mother’s life — at direct risk.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

In Austin, Amanda Zuraksi was losing her baby.

But under Abbott’s law, she could not receive abortion care — meaning she
had to wait until her body went into sepsis, resulting in a three-day
battle for her life in the Intensive Care Unit. The lasting effects of the
delayed care means she might not be able to have children in the future.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

In Corpus Christi, teenager Brooke Alexander found out she was pregnant 48
hours before Abbott’s first extreme abortion ban went into effect. She
raced to get an abortion.

But under Abbott’s law, she couldn’t. Her decision to control her own body
and future was taken from her by this governor.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

These are just a few of too many stories. Under Governor Abbott, Texas
women no longer control their own futures, bodies, or families.

Politicians like Abbott are forcing doctors to literally play chicken with
the lives of women like Amanda Zuraski. And Greg Abbott did all of this —
caused all of this suffering, fear, and harm — just to boost his own
political power.

That’s why I’m taking this moment to personally write you.

Three days from now, we have the opportunity to defeat Greg Abbott. To
show him that we are more powerful than him. And to elect a Governor who
is right alongside us in the fight to restore women's reproductive
freedom.

Right now is our last chance to funnel grassroots resources into critical
Get Out The Vote efforts across all 254 counties of Texas so we can elect
Beto O’Rourke as a pro-choice Governor.

Are you with me?

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20221105-1.rWUtuU&refcode=ema20221105-216024&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1004&akid=216024%2E444211%2EJlgsJW ]Will
you contribute for the
very first time to ensure Beto can defeat Greg Abbott on
Tuesday? It’s now or never in the fight for reproductive rights.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20221105-1.rWUtuU&refcode=ema20221105-216024&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1023&akid=216024%2E444211%2EJlgsJW ]Donate $3

It will take a victory in Texas to restore what is rightfully ours: the
ability to make our own decisions about our bodies. I believe we can win
this. We must.

In solidarity,

Cecile

Cecile Richards
National Finance Chair, Beto for Texas
Former President of Planned Parenthood

Dear Friend, I'm writing this letter to you today because, quite frankly, David Daleiden cannot. You may remember David as the undercover journalist who spent 30 months investigating and capturing video evidence of Planned Parenthood 's top leadership --- medical directors, national program directors, even its Senior Director of Medical Services -- **callously negotiating the harvesting and sale of aborted baby body parts.** **And now, he 's been charged with nine bogus felonies.** **[Which is why I'm asking you to make an emergency donation to the DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND right away.](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f2f19aee6c014607b0fe895a17a92355&_e=7LPoKHMDA2O37u_-qQXlrt2mZzirnGQaAOm24wamb356dq8_UeAPvKTEpnD8JfiokJyQvJWSRVfmVwLlHt90YO07sqOT4ThFAvOSk7zrdRPOvB8Fsb3UKQwrZ-Vu8UxHSHpfASb0B4Q98ObFsPj5zrB-xMhCMzFNVnArR-YQ83TjK5F1WfVYfXtjT9dmt30qgY467XND-EmpOmgLsvdkuLlzzL3AsK9Jf9TEZQaL62Tn4MAhFhLjjghOADTaomaWUjlP3PxxFoGx-zH8kZFm9lB3jrDkUPt3D5eo0vaRRwTAgqwO7q3h8BT-czv5x5MldZjM354jNdg8qr6e8x0IwHxnAK0Io1Qc3wJfsOhkA1f7nOTAcAV3-lE4siREecQzl0uohZ0uRt1pkTzfaxfQQQ%3D%3D)** You see, after David released the shocking videos of the illegal and disgusting actions of abortion executives, Kamala Harris, then California's Attorney General, colluded with Planned Parenthood to file felony charges against David... _**... Kamala Harris even ordered the California Department of Justice to raid David's home and confiscate his unpublished videos.**_ I won't sugarcoat it. If not cleared of these charges, David faces steep fines and years in state penitentiary and the consequences of being a convicted felon. While Kamala Harris --- a bought-and-paid-for ally of the abortion industry --- is sitting one heartbeat away from the presidency. That's the bad news. But here's the good news... David is fighting back. In fact, he's taking another opportunity to drag more of Planned Parenthood's dark criminality into the spotlight with two new federal lawsuits. That's right. The Thomas More Society has filed a federal civil rights lawsuit in California on behalf of David against former California Attorney General and now VicePresident Kamala Harris for prosecuting David in bad faith, twisting and perverting California's anti-eavesdropping law to persecute a citizen journalist because of his political views. Then the Thomas More Society filed a defamation (libel) lawsuit in federal court in New York against Planned Parenthood, which said David created a "fake" and "false" "smear campaign" against Planned Parenthood. In other words, the best defense is a good offense. The truth is we could no longer let David suffer such a trampling of his free speech and due process rights without a counterattack. The timing couldn't be more important. This is a critical opportunity to put Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the rest of the abortion industry on trial for conspiring to silence David in order to cover-up their illegal activities. **[That's where your emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND comes in --- by giving today you can stand with David in his hour of need.](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f2f19aee6c014607b0fe895a17a92355&_e=7LPoKHMDA2O37u_-qQXlrt2mZzirnGQaAOm24wamb356dq8_UeAPvKTEpnD8JfiokJyQvJWSRVfmVwLlHt90YO07sqOT4ThFAvOSk7zrdRPOvB8Fsb3UKQwrZ-Vu8UxHSHpfASb0B4Q98ObFsPj5zrB-xMhCMzFNVnArR-YQ83TjK5F1WfVYfXtjT9dmt30qgY467XND-EmpOmgLsvdkuLlzzL3AsK9Jf9TEZQaL62Tn4MAhFhLjjghOADTaomaW_lCEsJr1Aywixgrs68zyGoFUUACQ8fQHWi0F7n8oGnOsADou5gDrMS6rO4WF4AD0QX5evarfdrIIlcJB_BhAWxn2m1Y5tXc2NhF15OQaglN3PbmYMOOzZJDOf702hxzmxayOBkiRHQcFY8NYWVrJGw%3D%3D)** The reality is. . . You couldn't be there when David entered the dark underbelly of the abortion industry --- sitting across the table from abortionists haggling over the price of baby body parts with cold-blooded clarity... "I want a Lamborghini." You couldn't be there as David saw with his own eyes the preborn children who had been killed with great precision and delicacy to preserve their organs for maximum profit. You couldn't be there when the videos were released and Kamala Harris and Planned Parenthood conspired to crush David with trumped up legal charges and an armed raid on his home in which they seized laptops, hard-drives, and recording equipment. * The civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood where we are appealing the jury's verdict, along with the judge's order permanently banning David from doing any more undercover journalism against Planned Parenthood. clean_body: Dear Friend, I'm writing this letter to you today because, quite frankly, David Daleiden cannot. You may remember David as the undercover journalist who spent 30 months investigating and capturing video evidence of Planned Parenthood 's top leadership --- medical directors, national program directors, even its Senior Director of Medical Services -- callously negotiating the harvesting and sale of aborted baby body parts. And now, he 's been charged with nine bogus felonies. You see, after David released the shocking videos of the illegal and disgusting actions of abortion executives, Kamala Harris, then California's Attorney General, colluded with Planned Parenthood to file felony charges against David... ... Kamala Harris even ordered the California Department of Justice to raid David's home and confiscate his unpublished videos. I won't sugarcoat it. If not cleared of these charges, David faces steep fines and years in state penitentiary and the consequences of being a convicted felon. While Kamala Harris --- a bought-and-paid-for ally of the abortion industry --- is sitting one heartbeat away from the presidency. That's the bad news. But here's the good news... David is fighting back. In fact, he's taking another opportunity to drag more of Planned Parenthood's dark criminality into the spotlight with two new federal lawsuits. That's right. The Thomas More Society has filed a federal civil rights lawsuit in California on behalf of David against former California Attorney General and now VicePresident Kamala Harris for prosecuting David in bad faith, twisting and perverting California's anti-eavesdropping law to persecute a citizen journalist because of his political views. Then the Thomas More Society filed a defamation (libel) lawsuit in federal court in New York against Planned Parenthood, which said David created a "fake" and "false" "smear campaign" against Planned Parenthood. In other words, the best defense is a good offense. The truth is we could no longer let David suffer such a trampling of his free speech and due process rights without a counterattack. The timing couldn't be more important. This is a critical opportunity to put Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the rest of the abortion industry on trial for conspiring to silence David in order to cover-up their illegal activities. The reality is. . . You couldn't be there when David entered the dark underbelly of the abortion industry --- sitting across the table from abortionists haggling over the price of baby body parts with cold-blooded clarity... "I want a Lamborghini." You couldn't be there as David saw with his own eyes the preborn children who had been killed with great precision and delicacy to preserve their organs for maximum profit. You couldn't be there when the videos were released and Kamala Harris and Planned Parenthood conspired to crush David with trumped up legal charges and an armed raid on his home in which they seized laptops, hard-drives, and recording equipment. And you couldn't be there with David (our criminal defense team was there) when he voluntarily appeared in both Texas and California for booking and processing --- fingerprinted and photographed for a mugshot like a common criminal. But, now, this is the reality... there is something you can do. My name is Tom Brejcha. I'm the president and chief counsel of the Thomas More Society --- a not-for-profit law firm underwriting and helping to spearhead David's criminal defense. The Thomas More Society is proud to have defended many renowned pro-life and religious leaders in America's pro-life movement such as Joe, Ann, and Eric Scheidler, the Pro-Life Action League, Shawn Carney and 40 Days for Life, Abby Johnson, the Susan B. Anthony List, David Bereit, Lila Rose and Live Action, Students for Life, Sidewalk Advocates for Life, Created Equal, former Kansas Attorney General Phill Kline, the March for Life, and many more. Because when dark forces like Planned Parenthood unleash their full might to legally, financially, and personally destroy our clients --- we fight back. I have to tell you, despite all that David is facing, his spirits remain high. Of course, I've never known anyone in this kind of position who didn't feel an empty pit in his stomach. But David's not giving up. His willingness to fight back is a true profile in Pro-Life courage. Now I'll get right down to it... We anticipate David's legal defense will cost us more than $6 million. That's right, SIX MILLION DOLLARS. In addition to the criminal case and the new federal civil rights and defamation lawsuits, we're currently representing David in THREE other cases. The civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood where we are appealing the jury's verdict, along with the judge's order permanently banning David from doing any more undercover journalism against Planned Parenthood. Recently, we posted a $700,000 appeal bond to keep Planned Parenthood's nasty collection agents from harassing him with collection agents and even seizing his belongings. We're fighting back, but we'll need your help. The civil lawsuit brought by the National Abortion Federation and the "gag order" injunction that still prohibits David from releasing any more of his video evidence exposing Planned Parenthood's illegal fetal tissue business. And now, in light of the Planned Parenthood civil lawsuit, NAF has moved for summary judgment - they want a ruling against David without a trial at all! And finally, the civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood personnel in federal court in Seattle, where we just achieved a victory for a second time on appeal, but it appears we may need at least a third victory on appeal before this case ends. That's why David needs your financial support today. I won't guess how much you're able to send today. Whether it's $35, $50, $75, $125, $250, $500, $1,000 or more... ... I will only say that time is of the essence. So I do ask that you make your donation as soon as you can. This truly is a "David versus Goliath" type of battle --- with Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the radical left arrayed against our "David." It's a grave injustice that David is the one being hit with felony charges and massive civil penalties while Planned Parenthood (so far, at least) has gone unpunished. By clearing David of these charges... you and I can allow him to continue with his incredibly important lifesaving work. Remember, over 12 million people on YouTube alone watched the shocking footage he captured. Since that time, 26 states --- over half the country -- have moved to strip Planned Parenthood of taxpayer funding. It's no wonder Planned Parenthood and their allies want to destroy David. They'd love to see him rotting away in penitentiary rather than exposing their criminal and inhumane activities. You and I cannot let that happen. I've asked my staff to let me know as soon as we get it so I can let David know that you're standing with him. I know he'll be deeply touched by your generous support. May God Bless You, Tom Brejcha President & Chief Counsel P.S. Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and their allies want to destroy David. They'd love to see him rotting away in penitentiary rather than exposing their criminal, ghoulish activities. You and I cannot let that happen. body:
Our democracy is on the ballot.
#
Hi there. It's Lieutenant Colonel (Retired) Alexander Vindman.
When I reported the infamous phone call that led to Donald Trump's impeachment inquiry, I did it because someone had to hold him accountable.
I've witnessed firsthand the corruption and vitriol that Trump brought to our nation's highest level of government. And we've seen Ron Johnson serve as one of Trump's top enablers by participating in a scheme to rig the 2020 election results in Trump's favor.
**Our democracy is on the ballot in 2022, and all of us have a responsibility to hold Ron Johnson accountable. That is why I am proud to stand with Mandela Barnes in his campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin.**
Mandela's race is going to be one of the closest races in the entire country. It is also a critical opportunity to unseat a right-wing extremist who spreads misinformation, undermines U.S. national security, and threatens the future of our democracy.
In just 3 days, Mandela Barnes can defeat Ron Johnson – but only if people like you stand with him when it matters most. So today, I am asking you directly:
[**Can you please make a $3 contribution to help elect Mandela Barnes to the Senate? I wouldn't ask if it wasn't important.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mandela-em-nov22.Jaf-Cy&refcode=em221105-1-tt&t=1&akid=4030%2E196590%2En0lxAr)

We need more Democrats in the Senate who are prepared to hold Republicans accountable for the radical shift their party has taken during the era of Trump.
Mandela is someone we can count on to do that. Thank you for joining me in supporting his campaign today.
All my best,
Lt. Colonel (Ret.) Alexander Vindman

Derek, if the past week tells us anything, it’s that the extreme
zealots leading the Republican Party haven’t made a single effort to lower
the temperature in our political climate after January 6th.

It’s only getting hotter. And more dangerous.

Republican candidates, like that running for Arizona governor, joke about
the violence but there is nothing funny about it. In fact, it is deadly
serious.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=nov2022_abs_em.YLWDKC&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20221105_AM1_V1_S1_VSP&email=&t=1004&akid=1277%2E5257348%2Em6ZBFw ]GOP Arizona gubernatorial nominee Kari Lake jokes about political violence at
a campaign event while the crowd and moderator laugh

Many other Republicans have made similar – or worse – remarks.

And the response from the vast majority of Republican elected officials
and candidates?

Crickets.

Derek, there are two kinds of Republicans allowed in today’s
GOP:

The ones who deny elections, incite political violence, and vilify their
opponents.

And the ones who stand by and watch it happen — as democracy teeters on
the edge.

They don’t have the guts to stand up to extremists in their own party. Or
Trump.

They don’t have the integrity to condemn political violence when they
think it benefits them electorally.

And they don’t deserve one iota of political power.

So I’m asking, Derek:

You’ve heard me say it before, Derek: We’re at an inflection point in American history. What happens in the next two to three years is going to determine what this country looks like 30 years from now. It’s not hyperbole. **There’s so much at stake.** _Roe_ was settled for 50 years. But think about what’s happening. MAGA Republicans are banning abortion in the case of rape and incest in many states. **Well, Derek, if we elect two more Democratic senators and hold the House, we could codify _Roe._ We could once again make _Roe_ the law of the land.** **Election Day is Tuesday, and Kamala and I need to know you’re with us. But think about what’s happening. MAGA Republicans are banning abortion in the case of rape and incest in many states. Well, Derek, if we elect two more Democratic senators and hold the House, we could codify Roe. We could once again make Roe the law of the land. Make a $7 donation to the DNC today to help elect more Democrats to the Senate, protect our House majority, and ensure Democrats nationwide have the resources to win. Fellow American,

According to a new poll, Raphael Warnock is winning the Georgia Senate race 61-34 among _early voters_.

History shows us that Democrats prefer to vote early, and Republicans tend to vote on Election Day.

But let those polling numbers sink in for a moment. While most recent polls show this race is TIED, we would likely lose if Election Day voters (who tend to be more Republican) do not turn out to vote.

_This is a CRITICAL REMINDER that we MUST WORK HARD in the final days to turn out our voters on Election Day._ We cannot be complacent or rely on a magical "Red Wave" to win. We must do the HARD and IMPORTANT work of contacting and turning out our voters.

We have not fully funded our budget for the final push, so we desperately need your help. clean_body: According to a new poll, Warnock is winning 61-34 among early voters. | Fellow American, According to a new poll, Raphael Warnock is winning the Georgia Senate race 61-34 among early voters. History shows us that Democrats prefer to vote early, and Republicans tend to vote on Election Day. But let those polling numbers sink in for a moment. While most recent polls show this race is TIED, we would likely lose if Election Day voters (who tend to be more Republican) do not turn out to vote. This is a CRITICAL REMINDER that we MUST WORK HARD in the final days to turn out our voters on Election Day. We cannot be complacent or rely on a magical "Red Wave" to win. We must do the HARD and IMPORTANT work of contacting and turning out our voters. We have not fully funded our budget for the final push, so we desperately need your help. Just remember: the Senate majority runs through Georgia. Without a victory here, it's virtually impossible for Republicans to control the Senate and stop Joe Biden. [1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Over 2.2 million votes have been cast in this election already.

That number dwarfs the number of votes cast at this point in 2018 and
reflects the energy that flipped Georgia blue in 2020 and
2021, Derek.

But as historic as these numbers are, we still have to turn out a whole
lot of voters on Election Day if we’re going to win this race.

Derek. And we need your help to
spread Stacey’s message as far as humanly possible before then. So, will
you donate $5 now to turn out our final round of voters and
show Brian Kemp, the media and the world that we have a leader worth every
penny of our investments?

Brian Kemp is a far-right extremist who is too dangerous for Georgia. His
extreme and unpopular agenda hurts Georgians: his “criminal carry” policy
puts lives at risk, his refusal to expand Medicaid closes hospitals and
his cruel anti-abortion mandate hurts women.

Four more years of his radical policies would threaten our state’s future
and our freedoms, and it favors the wealthy few at the expense of
hardworking families across Georgia.

But if we elect Stacey Abrams, she’s going to begin putting in the work
for the people of Georgia on Day 1.

She’s going to work day and night to make sure that Brian Kemp’s legacy of
harm and neglect is anything but permanent — and will work to ensure that
everyone who’s been left behind over these last four years can thrive.

But making Stacey’s vision a reality is contingent on our work
today, Derek.
And we will never get this time back.

election and get them to the polls on Tuesday. So,
Derek: will you invest

body:
The winner of this Governor’s race will have a lot of power over the future of Pennsylvania. This is a consequential election for everyone living here, and so it’s critical I have your support in this tough race.

Derek — here in Pennsylvania, I’m running for Governor to take on the big fights and help Pennsylvanians get ahead. I’m determined to protect abortion rights, expand access to the ballot box, tackle rising costs, and create more economic opportunities. As your next Governor, I have a lot of ideas for how to do all that — how to help families not just get by, but get ahead. That’s why I’m humbly asking for your personal endorsement before Election Day, Derek. **[Will you become an official supporter of our campaign to protect our democracy and our freedoms here in Pennsylvania?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54117939/377498987/-146964294?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZDAyODYwZS0zYzVkLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AziMY2E4PNSiZjnyBwe1dw2kpo6ew59fEfyM-9Ut33s=&emci=15282b3a-ab5c-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=fd02860e-3c5d-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=21962291)** | | [Add your name →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54117941/377498994/-146964294?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZDAyODYwZS0zYzVkLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AziMY2E4PNSiZjnyBwe1dw2kpo6ew59fEfyM-9Ut33s=&emci=15282b3a-ab5c-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=fd02860e-3c5d-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=21962291)

The stakes of this race are so high, Derek.
* In our post-_Roe_ world, reproductive rights will be determined on a state-by-state basis, meaning the next Governor will decide if abortion remains safe, legal, and accessible here in Pennsylvania. My opponent says his “#1 issue” is passing an abortion ban with absolutely no exceptions — a bill I wouldn’t hesitate to veto.

* The very foundations of our democracy are at stake because the next Governor will appoint the official who runs our elections — and will get to decide how we vote in future elections.

* The ability to unionize is at risk. I will defend workers’ rights — my extreme opponent would work to destroy the union way of life.

* Rising costs have hit all of us — but especially those Pennsylvanians making the minimum wage, which sits at $7.25/hour. My opponent is against raising the minimum wage. I believe no one in Pennsylvania should be forced to live on poverty-level wages.

**Here’s the thing, Derek: the winner of this Governor’s race will have a lot of power over the future of Pennsylvania. This is a consequential election for everyone living here, and so it’s critical I have your support in this tough race.**
**[If we’re going to win, it needs to be all-hands-on-deck for the next three days. Will you join me?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54117942/377498995/-146964294?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZDAyODYwZS0zYzVkLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AziMY2E4PNSiZjnyBwe1dw2kpo6ew59fEfyM-9Ut33s=&emci=15282b3a-ab5c-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=fd02860e-3c5d-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=21962291)**
Thank you. Let’s win this thing.
Josh Shapiro

subject: Why We Support Adam Laxalt
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Laxalt for Senate
body:
The Midterm Election happening now, and your voice is more critical than ever | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/adamlaxalt/mastomisinformation-7417631?e=018ab83301)
---
|
---
| | **A brief message in support of Adam Laxalt from former Lieutenant Governor Lorraine Hunt and former State Treasurer Patty Cafferata:**

Fellow Nevadans, As two women elected to statewide positions in Nevada - a former lieutenant governor and a former state treasurer - we know what it takes to represent the people of Nevada. Adam's record as Nevada's attorney general proves that he is the right choice for US Senate.
As Nevada’s attorney general, Adam established the first-of-its-kind Office of Military Legal Assistance, which helped those serving in the military access free legal services, the bipartisan “Prescription for Addiction” initiative to fight opioid abuse, the “Financial Fraud and Guardianship Abuse Unit” to help protect elderly Nevadans from identity theft and scams, and regular Law Enforcement Summits to help state, local, and tribal law enforcement agencies work together to fight crime. Most importantly, he increased protections for victims of domestic violence, expanded resources for victims, and worked with law enforcement to process more than 8,000 rape kits from Nevada's backlog, which had left victims waiting for justice for years before action was taken. Processing these rape kits led to the conviction of serial rapists and murderers who had been on the loose for years before Adam took initiative as Attorney General.

This is why Adam is endorsed by 95% of law enforcement in Nevada, including the Nevada Fraternal Order of Police and the Public Safety Alliance of Nevada (PSAN), which represents over 10,000 law Enforcement Officers throughout over 100 state and local organizations. Many police organizations switched their endorsement from Sen. Cortez Masto to Adam because of her soft-on-crime approach and her affiliation with far-left radicals who support defunding the police.
Your vote is crucial in this fight to save Nevada. It’s up to us to unite and get out the vote for Adam Laxalt. If we sit on the sidelines, out-of-touch Democrats will continue to destroy our country, our economy, and our communities. We can't let that happen. Please, make sure that you have a plan to vote on Election Day. We must take action to elect Adam Laxalt as our next U.S. Senator. Regards and Best Wishes, Patty Cafferata, 17th Treasurer of Nevada (1983-1987)

Lorraine Hunt, 32nd Lieutenant Governor of Nevada (1999-2007)

But somehow, our completely factual ads about MAGA Republicans and their plans to contest the 2024 election failed to pass Facebook’s review process. _So what’s up with that?!_ We wish we knew. But what we do know is that the future of our democracy hangs in the balance — largely because of misinformation — and Facebook still won’t do what’s necessary to help. The best way to stand up to Mark Zuckerberg is to join the work to fight back against the disinformation that Zuckerberg won't do anything about, and we've got a plan for that. [**That’s why we’re reaching out, friend. Add your name if you’re with us to fight the right-wing disinformation that Zuckerberg won’t. We’ll give you easy, concrete ways to take action. **](https://default.salsalabs.org/T90a5ee19-1f67-4e36-bf9e-2c66ff7f7ebb/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| [](http://links.savecarolina.org/u/click?_t=13365b87b52649cc8d23e393a66fd89d&_m=6d895927b24d4b339120ba9373c0a31d&_e=m7MHIyRWBavspRxfIlewrnziw4koTgI6jA9zkSXNkUw4KVNk2N7GAAu4fyjNuKX2gePncuv90nQH8burmm9deYgNRYgIqy6-3jZDWrIxBwP_6UC7DCk_Zu78z44-SsjZkEv7bx43dbwo-WPV-ljbTIKiQBPZ-K-uXmOGvAsL4vdifMg7Kp81xf1qRfqg53VdNYOJWsoGXomgL7f5s_KNkLbYJTxQw35r0HG00F6HR9X7GDZBIY7Fa-Tg2jFicJ2gG9AKv35a9ij6XajRbwL_qjb8kA293Nkx5aBZNjeeMXQ35VIrpIRmVEqOUvd1ejqGXdv57uDWrZbLthxes4zKvgvGTeXwY6sIlNQWKj6iqM3BnA8SUA8Fl948w_971kCnOXDeBm2FJkcxIlah2QmilNkuHM-9Zq3vxkmrk8PmwpM2gjWtbMJ4LBB5uldETvptsZYlCs-st7629oaV2a6OQrfox6BajpQvJGi_ZmwTr4U%3D)

**_Recent polls are worrying:_**

[**I’m losing.**](http://links.savecarolina.org/u/click?_t=13365b87b52649cc8d23e393a66fd89d&_m=6d895927b24d4b339120ba9373c0a31d&_e=m7MHIyRWBavspRxfIlewrnziw4koTgI6jA9zkSXNkUw4KVNk2N7GAAu4fyjNuKX2gePncuv90nQH8burmm9deYgNRYgIqy6-3jZDWrIxBwP_6UC7DCk_Zu78z44-SsjZkEv7bx43dbwo-WPV-ljbTIKiQBPZ-K-uXmOGvAsL4vdifMg7Kp81xf1qRfqg53VdNYOJWsoGXomgL7f5s_KNkLbYJTxQw35r0HG00F6HR9X7GDZBIY7Fa-Tg2jFicJ2gG9AKv35a9ij6XajRbwL_qjb8kA293Nkx5aBZNjeeMXQ35VIrpIRmVEqOUvd1ejqGXdv57uDWrZbLthxes4zKvvo5RnreDNLvx0VxQ4gdvV-NtIcj54bOZdnkxhrOpxWk05pAH5YBDuqMQy_-fN2BqtMhkZEC8bB0pdbz-gqb0fegy4dcpD4YdW3BdJ5gzpwo0nZKtyt2htltrkW7n4LuvzKyNtv8_aQqgQKKINoKP98%3D)
And I’m not only losing against a Democrat opponent. **_I’m losing against a RADICAL LEFTIST who will strip away your freedom and advance Biden’s woke agenda._**
| [**HELP ME PUSH BACK**](http://links.savecarolina.org/u/click?_t=13365b87b52649cc8d23e393a66fd89d&_m=6d895927b24d4b339120ba9373c0a31d&_e=m7MHIyRWBavspRxfIlewrnziw4koTgI6jA9zkSXNkUw4KVNk2N7GAAu4fyjNuKX2gePncuv90nQH8burmm9deYgNRYgIqy6-3jZDWrIxBwP_6UC7DCk_Zu78z44-SsjZkEv7bx43dbwo-WPV-ljbTIKiQBPZ-K-uXmOGvAsL4vdifMg7Kp81xf1qRfqg53VdNYOJWsoGXomgL7f5s_KNkLbYJTxQw35r0HG00F6HR9X7GDZBIY7Fa-Tg2jFicJ2gG9AKv35a9ij6XajRbwL_qjb8kA293Nkx5aBZNjeeMXQ35VIrpIRmVEqOUvd1ejqGXdv57uDWrZbLthxes4zKvoHFtbcP-K31H62oKl-sZHlbWI4z_8pGTh1j7NtA4sXAt5JyINJnemHYlk6Nui67LK-Gmnvx4sl846IZnyDDRXgTXYXRx3F_xGk7bpbeiGnoXYqgRNP8SAp2co3c9-Bl0-asJGqkK2cdhopWvw0H6dM%3D)

And I’m not the only one struggling. Republicans around the country are in the same boat - that even includes Ted Budd, who is fighting a key Senate race in North Carolina.

We need your help to move forward in these last weeks before the election. [**_We still have a chance at taking back the Senate, but only if you join us and support our work. name: Candace Owens, Co-founder of BLEXIT
subject: The most personal email I’ve ever sent you
body:
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61803215:6uxDd8GN7:m:1:3369487795:43D1E83DE6CB5A74F8DF9EED26F47360:r)

Peter,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61803215:6uxDd8GN7:m:1:3369487795:43D1E83DE6CB5A74F8DF9EED26F47360:r)

**_Now I 'll share my story_... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I've dealt with racism... _**I 've even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Peter, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $25, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61803215:6uxDd8GN7:m:1:3369487795:43D1E83DE6CB5A74F8DF9EED26F47360:r)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I 'm not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61803215:6uxDd8GN7:m:1:3369487795:43D1E83DE6CB5A74F8DF9EED26F47360:r)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61803215:6uxDd8GN7:m:1:3369487795:43D1E83DE6CB5A74F8DF9EED26F47360:r)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61803215:6uxDd8GN7:m:1:3369487795:43D1E83DE6CB5A74F8DF9EED26F47360:r)

* **Teaching History: **Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61803215:6uxDd8GN7:m:1:3369487795:43D1E83DE6CB5A74F8DF9EED26F47360:r)

* **Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore.

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. [_**Please support BLEXIT 's events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61803215:6uxDd8GN7:m:1:3369487795:43D1E83DE6CB5A74F8DF9EED26F47360:r)

What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.

This is personal to me.

I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot.

Peter, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today:

[_**Donate $25 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61803216:6uxDd8GN7:m:1:3369487795:43D1E83DE6CB5A74F8DF9EED26F47360:r)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61803217:6uxDd8GN7:m:1:3369487795:43D1E83DE6CB5A74F8DF9EED26F47360:r)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61803218:6uxDd8GN7:m:1:3369487795:43D1E83DE6CB5A74F8DF9EED26F47360:r)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61803219:6uxDd8GN7:m:1:3369487795:43D1E83DE6CB5A74F8DF9EED26F47360:r)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61803220:6uxDd8GN7:m:1:3369487795:43D1E83DE6CB5A74F8DF9EED26F47360:r)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61803221:6uxDd8GN7:m:1:3369487795:43D1E83DE6CB5A74F8DF9EED26F47360:r)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61803222:6uxDd8GN7:m:1:3369487795:43D1E83DE6CB5A74F8DF9EED26F47360:r)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61803223:6uxDd8GN7:m:1:3369487795:43D1E83DE6CB5A74F8DF9EED26F47360:r)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61803215:6uxDd8GN7:m:1:3369487795:43D1E83DE6CB5A74F8DF9EED26F47360:r)

This is my last message to you before you close this email.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment.

My burning desire is to use my voice and change the direction of our urban communities and the country. The BLEXIT Foundation has a real impact, and I am inviting you to join our cause.

[_**Please consider making the most generous donation you can today by clicking here.**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61803215:6uxDd8GN7:m:1:3369487795:43D1E83DE6CB5A74F8DF9EED26F47360:r)

Thank you, Peter.

Candace Owens
President
BLEXIT Foundation

body:
| | |

If we've learned nothing else these last few years, it's that we are more in the dark about China and their reach than we had ever considered. And while some of those ways are known to you now, were you aware of their hold on your cell phone? Our cell phones, along with other electronics like tablets and computers, are reliant on technology that China wants to control. Big Tech and the Chinese Communists – a disastrous combination! | **Voters to decide four amendments and a convention call**
Voters on Nov. 8 will decide the fate of four proposed constitutional amendments – including controversial proposals to legalize marijuana for recreational use and authorize state lawmakers to impose unfunded mandates on Kansas City – in addition to determining if a special convention should be held to rewrite the Missouri Constitution.

Amendment 3, the most high-profile of the measures, seeks to legalize recreational marijuana use for adults age 21 and older while also providing for the automatic expungement of criminal convictions for most past non-violent marijuana convictions. However, some legalization supporters oppose Amendment 3 because it essentially would give Missouri’s existing medical marijuana industry constitutional control over the recreational market.

Also sparking controversy is Amendment 4, which would weaken the state Hancock Amendment’s existing constitutional prohibition against imposing unfunded state mandates on local governments in order to force the Kansas City municipal government to increase spending on the city’s police department, which is controlled by the state but entirely funded by local taxpayers. The amendment comes as retaliation by Republican state lawmakers after Kansas City officials sought input in how the state-controlled police board spends local tax dollars.

The remaining two proposed amendments have garnered little attention. Amendment 1 would grant lawmakers the power to statutorily override existing constitutional restrictions on how the state treasurer can invest taxpayer funds, while Amendment 5 would elevate the Missouri National Guard to departmental status, a change that likely would have little, if any, practical impact since the governor already has direct constitutional control of the Guard.

The final statewide ballot measure asks if voters want to call a special convention for the purpose of overhauling or replacing the existing Missouri Constitution, which has been in use since 1945 and is the state’s fourth. If voters authorize a convention, delegate elections would be held early next year, and the convention could begin meeting thereafter. Missouri voters ultimately would have to ratify any proposed new constitution or amendments to the existing one.
---
|
---
| **U.S. senator, state auditor elections top Nov. 8 ballot**
Missouri voters will head to the polls Nov. 8 to choose a new U.S. senator and a new state auditor, as well as elect state lawmakers and members of Missouri’s congressional delegation under newly established district boundaries.

The marquee race on this year’s ballot is between Democrat Trudy Busch Valentine and Republican Attorney General Eric Schmitt for an open U.S. Senate seat. The winner will replace incumbent U.S. Sen. Roy Blunt, a Republican who is retiring after two terms.

Also stepping down after two terms is State Auditor Nicole Galloway, who is the only remaining Democrat statewide officeholder in Missouri. The major party candidates to replace her are Democrat Alan Green, a former state representative from Florissant, and State Treasurer Scott Fitzpatrick, who hails from rural Barry County in southwest Missouri.

Gov. Mike Parson, a Republican, appointed Schmitt and Fitzpatrick to their current offices to fill vacancies early 2019, and both went on to win full terms in 2020. If either is elected to a new post this year, Parson would pick their successor, who would serve out the remainder of the term, which runs through 2024.

All 163 members of the state House of Representatives and half of the 34-member Senate are on the ballot. Legislative candidates will be running for the first time in new districts drawn earlier this year to reflect population shifts under the 2020 U.S. Census. Republicans currently outnumber Democrats 24-10 in the Senate and 114-49 in the House, counting several vacancies toward the party that most recently held them. Candidates in Missouri’s eight congressional districts also are running under new boundaries, with the current partisan split of six Republicans and two Democrats expected to be preserved.

| **HELP FOR SMALL BUSINESS AND NON- PROFITS **
The U.S. Small Business Administration approved Missouri’s request for assistance through the federal agency’s disaster loan program. This move makes low-interest disaster loans available to small businesses and private non-profits severely impacted by the Coronavirus (COVID-19).

SBA’s Economic Injury Disaster Loans offer up to $2 million in assistance for each affected small business or non-profit. These loans can provide vital economic support to small businesses to help overcome the temporary loss of revenue they are experiencing.

Applicants will be able to apply online, receive additional disaster assistance information and [download applications](https://robertsforstl.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6e3f7ee3b541518ea63c7e773&id=a55181ab2e&e=a088917f89). Applicants may also call SBA’s Customer Service Center at (800) 659-2955 or email [disastercustomerservice@sba.gov](mailto:disastercustomerservice@sba.gov) for more information on SBA disaster assistance.

Capitol Ave., Rm 329 Jefferson City, MO 65101 (573) 751-4415 Steve.Roberts@senate.mo.gov | | | | | | | | | | | | Voters to decide four amendments and a convention call Voters on Nov. 8 will decide the fate of four proposed constitutional amendments – including controversial proposals to legalize marijuana for recreational use and authorize state lawmakers to impose unfunded mandates on Kansas City – in addition to determining if a special convention should be held to rewrite the Missouri Constitution. Amendment 3, the most high-profile of the measures, seeks to legalize recreational marijuana use for adults age 21 and older while also providing for the automatic expungement of criminal convictions for most past non-violent marijuana convictions. However, some legalization supporters oppose Amendment 3 because it essentially would give Missouri’s existing medical marijuana industry constitutional control over the recreational market. Also sparking controversy is Amendment 4, which would weaken the state Hancock Amendment’s existing constitutional prohibition against imposing unfunded state mandates on local governments in order to force the Kansas City municipal government to increase spending on the city’s police department, which is controlled by the state but entirely funded by local taxpayers. The amendment comes as retaliation by Republican state lawmakers after Kansas City officials sought input in how the state-controlled police board spends local tax dollars. The remaining two proposed amendments have garnered little attention. Amendment 1 would grant lawmakers the power to statutorily override existing constitutional restrictions on how the state treasurer can invest taxpayer funds, while Amendment 5 would elevate the Missouri National Guard to departmental status, a change that likely would have little, if any, practical impact since the governor already has direct constitutional control of the Guard. The final statewide ballot measure asks if voters want to call a special convention for the purpose of overhauling or replacing the existing Missouri Constitution, which has been in use since 1945 and is the state’s fourth. If voters authorize a convention, delegate elections would be held early next year, and the convention could begin meeting thereafter. Missouri voters ultimately would have to ratify any proposed new constitution or amendments to the existing one. | | U.S. senator, state auditor elections top Nov. 8 ballot Missouri voters will head to the polls Nov. 8 to choose a new U.S. senator and a new state auditor, as well as elect state lawmakers and members of Missouri’s congressional delegation under newly established district boundaries. The marquee race on this year’s ballot is between Democrat Trudy Busch Valentine and Republican Attorney General Eric Schmitt for an open U.S. Senate seat. The winner will replace incumbent U.S. Sen. Roy Blunt, a Republican who is retiring after two terms. Also stepping down after two terms is State Auditor Nicole Galloway, who is the only remaining Democrat statewide officeholder in Missouri. The major party candidates to replace her are Democrat Alan Green, a former state representative from Florissant, and State Treasurer Scott Fitzpatrick, who hails from rural Barry County in southwest Missouri. Gov. Mike Parson, a Republican, appointed Schmitt and Fitzpatrick to their current offices to fill vacancies early 2019, and both went on to win full terms in 2020. If either is elected to a new post this year, Parson would pick their successor, who would serve out the remainder of the term, which runs through 2024. All 163 members of the state House of Representatives and half of the 34-member Senate are on the ballot. Legislative candidates will be running for the first time in new districts drawn earlier this year to reflect population shifts under the 2020 U.S. Census. Republicans currently outnumber Democrats 24-10 in the Senate and 114-49 in the House, counting several vacancies toward the party that most recently held them. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54110394/377470808/368400405?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjAzMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5YTExZjlkNS0yNTVkLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=POw6kpDi04nTrdkmB4982OVR8COS8QdCva5zSupQU9o=&emci=79657cef-1d5d-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=9a11f9d5-255d-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=14943357) Peter, Politics can be complicated, but there’s one maxim that is simple and easy to follow: _**don’t lie.**_ Children are taught that lying is wrong from a young age. If you lie to your employer, or to the government, for example, there are serious consequences—you can be fired, or worse, if you are caught lying. Politicians think they can lie to the media and to voters only because they believe they can get away with it. And when they are called out, it is easy to muddy the waters and try to complicate the context surrounding the lie. _This is exactly what Ann Wagner does, and what she did when KSDK fact-checked her after I said she voted against our right to access birth control:_ [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54110395/377470809/1611632567?refcode=lies&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjAzMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5YTExZjlkNS0yNTVkLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=POw6kpDi04nTrdkmB4982OVR8COS8QdCva5zSupQU9o=) This kind of equivocation from someone entrusted to represent us in Congress is unacceptable. Rep. Wagner should at least have the integrity and the courage to stand by her votes, and her beliefs. **But we have come to expect the opposite from her year after year.** The truth is, Ann simply does not think Americans have a right to contraception and other forms of birth control. She does not believe that women should be in charge of their own reproductive healthcare decisions, and that the government should be involved in our most intimate and private choices, such as when and how to start a family. This is the decision set before the voters—reelect a person who lies with a straight face about something as basic as whether we have a right to access birth control; or vote for someone who is clear and upfront about their views, who shows up in every community, and listens and works for them. **The choice between myself and Ann Wagner is crystal clear.** Now, we need to keep working to make sure we reach as many voters as we can with this message before Election Day. I want to thank you for helping my team and I do this hard work every single day. clean_body: Peter, Politics can be complicated, but there’s one maxim that is simple and easy to follow: don’t lie. Children are taught that lying is wrong from a young age. If you lie to your employer, or to the government, for example, there are serious consequences—you can be fired, or worse, if you are caught lying. Politicians think they can lie to the media and to voters only because they believe they can get away with it. And when they are called out, it is easy to muddy the waters and try to complicate the context surrounding the lie. This is exactly what Ann Wagner does, and what she did when KSDK fact-checked her after I said she voted against our right to access birth control: = This kind of equivocation from someone entrusted to represent us in Congress is unacceptable. Rep. Wagner should at least have the integrity and the courage to stand by her votes, and her beliefs. But we have come to expect the opposite from her year after year. The truth is, Ann simply does not think Americans have a right to contraception and other forms of birth control. She does not believe that women should be in charge of their own reproductive healthcare decisions, and that the government should be involved in our most intimate and private choices, such as when and how to start a family. This is the decision set before the voters—reelect a person who lies with a straight face about something as basic as whether we have a right to access birth control; or vote for someone who is clear and upfront about their views, who shows up in every community, and listens and works for them. The choice between myself and Ann Wagner is crystal clear. Now, we need to keep working to make sure we reach as many voters as we can with this message before Election Day. I want to thank you for helping my team and I do this hard work every single day. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = = = = Thank you so much for your support, and here's to a big win on Tuesday and beyond! Friend, I’m writing to you today on behalf of my mom, Brenda Siegel. **** I’ve seen her fight day in and day out to make our state a better place. She’s not your average politician. She only cares about the people and the planet. She doesn't care who you are or where you come from or what you believe, if you need help she will give it. **** I am so proud of my mom. I have watched endorsements roll in from Congressman Welch, Becca Balint, Ben & Jerry, Treasurer Pearce, Governor Howard Dean and all of legislative leadership and at every turn been proud of how far she has come. But, what I know is that my mom would do this for all of us no matter what. This is a really hard race and she did something that no one else had the guts to. That may surprise all of you, but, it doesn't me. This is the Brenda Siegel I have known my whole life.

clean_body: | | Friend, I’m writing to you today on behalf of my mom, Brenda Siegel. ** I’ve seen her fight day in and day out to make our state a better place. She’s not your average politician. She only cares about the people and the planet. She doesn't care who you are or where you come from or what you believe, if you need help she will give it. ** I am so proud of my mom. I have watched endorsements roll in from Congressman Welch, Becca Balint, Ben & Jerry, Treasurer Pearce, Governor Howard Dean and all of legislative leadership and at every turn been proud of how far she has come. But, what I know is that my mom would do this for all of us no matter what. This is a really hard race and she did something that no one else had the guts to. That may surprise all of you, but, it doesn't me. This is the Brenda Siegel I have known my whole life. | As a mom she was my champion. In addition to me, she helped raise several kids that were not her own. She is always giving to all of us. Let's help her have more tools to do that. That is why I am writing today to make sure that we have her back as much as I know she has all of your backs. There are just three days until the election, and she needs additional support to unseat the Republican Governor. She needs our help. Let's show up strong for my mom right now and make sure she knows that we are all ready for this moment. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | Thank you again and let’s show up big for my mom and most importantly for Vermont.
