body:
if these MAGA candidates win, they will do everything they can to pave the way for Donald Trump in 2024.
#

Hi Friends,
In a minute, I’m going to ask you to [**make a contribution to DASS — the Democratic Association of Secretaries of State.**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-nov22-dass.OL9gmz&refcode=em221105-1-120&t=1&akid=1125%2E159979%2EoX_Wf9)
But first, I wanted to explain why I’m asking.
Right now, in battleground states across the country, election deniers are in very close races — and in some cases even leading in the polls — for Secretary of State positions.
These are candidates who have denied the result of elections, promised to make it harder to vote, and who have practically said they’ll only certify elections in which their preferred candidate wins.
As a former California Secretary of State myself, I know how important it is to have people in these roles that believe in democracy and making it as accessible as possible for all of us.
When I was California’s Secretary of State, we expanded voter outreach programs, increased voter registration, and did everything we could to make it as easy as possible to participate in our democracy.
But the far-right Republicans running for these positions in states like Arizona and Wisconsin have said that they’re running not to make democracy more accessible to everyone, but to make sure their candidates win.
**Honestly, the number of these election-denying candidates in close races across the country is a scary sign for our democracy.**
And I’m worried about what could happen in 2024 if one of them wins in a swing state like Arizona or Wisconsin — they could refuse to certify a presidential election if they don’t like the results and throw our democracy into chaos.
Secretary of State races tend to go under the radar compared to races for the House and Senate, but the truth is that these races are some of the most important in the entire country.
And the work that DASS is putting in this weekend will go a LONG way toward making sure pro-democracy candidates prevail.
So, what do you say?
[**Will you join me in supporting Democratic Secretary of State candidates across the country by making a contribution to DASS today? They’re counting on our help to elect pro-democracy Secretaries of State across the country.**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-nov22-dass.OL9gmz&refcode=em221105-1-120&t=2&akid=1125%2E159979%2EoX_Wf9)

Thank you,
Alex Padilla
U.S. Senator for California
Former Secretary of State of California

Peter,

Would you believe me if I said that a mother watched videos of her daughter having sex with her boyfriend and picked which one her daughter looked best in to **sell?**

Because that's exactly what happened -- Kris Jenner watched AND hand-picked which sex tape her daughter Kim Kardashian would release!

**It is not an exaggeration to say that Hollywood is satanic.**
What could possibly be more satanic than a mother using her daughter's body to sell sex?

If that disgusts you, here's where it gets worse. _It worked_. Kim Kardashian is a billionaire, and she's still selling sex.

She is symbolic of the society we live in today. That if you are willing to degrade yourself, if you're willing to denigrate yourself, then our society will give you more.

**Is this the example we want to leave for our children?**

At BLEXIT, we believe families should be grounded in faith and honor and respect their children and protect their innocence.

My name is Candace Owens, co-founder of the BLEXIT Foundation. BLEXIT focuses on educating minorities about the history of our great country, the principles of the Constitution, and the importance of self-reliance.

I've set a goal to raise $50,000 by the end of the month to show the next generation that they don't have to be like the Kardashians to be successful.

BLEXIT is bringing pro-America, pro-Family values to Black and minority communities through the work of our State Chapters.

Our Chapters spread the universal principles of the BLEXIT movement at the local level through community service, social engagement, educational activities, and virtual events.

They demonstrate how people can escape the mentality of victimhood and empower others to take control of their destinies.

Just this summer, **BLEXIT-Fest in New Jersey introduced our message to over 400 people.** They had a variety of talented performers and speakers and created a memorable community celebration.

**BLEXIT chapter members from our Tampa, FL, and North Charleston, SC sites educated and cared for approximately 80 children** for six weeks during our full-day Summer Camp.

The children in our Tampa program even took a field trip to Legoland!

Now that school has started, these BLEXIT chapters are providing an after-school youth education program - Liberation Camp - for 80 children.

_BLEXIT 's Chapters are a huge part of our Back to School initiative_.

The BLEXIT Illinois Chapter **distributed over 400 school supplies** and BLEXIT merchandise in one of Chicago's most impoverished communities. The NY Chapter was fortunate to **give away 120 school supply kits as well as 40 book bags.**

BLEXIT Chapters are changing the narrative that surrounds America's minority communities.

[**We currently have 42 chapters across the US and more than 14,000 volunteers! You can help BLEXIT support our State Chapters by donating $25, $35, $50, or any other amount today. Click here to send your gift >>>**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61803674:JUeOh8GNj:m:1:3370555685:93DB4E2C584DE2908504676C7EF0DB6D:r)

BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence reinforced by groups that market themselves as serving the Black community, such as Black Lives Matter, but in actuality, they destroy communities.

These organizations are poisoning minority communities. They tell these bright young men and women they are victims of systematic repression and that their skin color is all that defines them.

But here's the ugly truth about other organizations who claim to serve the Black community:

* They claim to support Black communities. . . but they fan the flames of riots and violence that directly impact the lives of the people in those communities.

* They claim to fight for criminal justice reform. . . but they teach Black men and women to hate and disrespect police officers.

* They claim to be a non-profit group fighting for Black men and women. . . but they use donor funds to enrich themselves.

**These other organizations are destroying Black communities, dividing our country, and forcing a message of victimhood and hatred down the throats of minorities.**

BLEXIT is countering their hateful narrative, but we can't do it alone, Peter. Can you donate to BLEXIT today and help us reach our goal of raising $50,000?

body:
I need folks like you to come through for our campaign once more.
#

Running for Senate required a big leap of faith — faith in our mission and faith that enough people like you would step up to support us. Winning a race as tough as this has to be a team effort. It requires all of us to do the hard work together.
It means so much to me to know that hundreds of thousands of people have donated to this campaign. I’m grateful to every person who has raised their hand to say they believe in our campaign and share our vision for a brighter future. Grassroots donations from folks like you allowed us to make critical investments that have put us in a strong position to win on Tuesday.
It’s humbling to think about the people-powered movement we’ve built.
Now I need folks like you to come through for our campaign once more. We noticed a bit of a fundraising slowdown yesterday, and honestly, it was a bit concerning because we’re trying to make the largest get-out-the-vote push we’ve ever attempted this weekend. The organizing goals are higher than ever before.
[**Please pitch in today to help us flip North Carolina’s Senate seat. If you believe a brighter future is possible, we need your help to make it a reality by winning this race and expanding our Senate majority.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-nov22.g3HOlK&refcode=em221105-2-MA&t=1&akid=2243%2E357359%2EYhpr4z)

---
****
| **[Other Amount](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2573?c0=cb-em-nov22.uectPl&refcode=em221105-2-MA&refcode2=2243.357359.Yhpr4z&t=25&akid=2243%2E357359%2EYhpr4z)**
---
****
My opponent Ted Budd thinks he can just let special interests buy this seat for him, and in return, he’ll continue doing exactly what he’s done in Congress — voting to keep the system rigged in favor of billionaires and corporations.
He will fight for a future where abortion is banned in every state, where marriage equality is overturned, and where corporations continue to rip off our families while they rake in record profits. It’s time for change.
North Carolina desperately needs a voice for working people in the U.S. Senate — not someone who will cater to corporations or special interests. I believe we deserve a leader in Washington who understands the hopes and needs of our families and fights for them. She must not be afraid to stand up to the powerful insiders and interests desperate to uphold a corrupt status quo.
That is exactly what I will do, but first, we have to make sure we have the resources to get across the finish line and win.
I am counting on you. [**Please donate to ensure we have every resource necessary to turn North Carolina blue. I only ask because I know just how important your support will be when the votes are counted.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-nov22.g3HOlK&refcode=em221105-2-MA&t=26&akid=2243%2E357359%2EYhpr4z)
I’m running this race to be a voice for people just like you. I will not accept a future where our children have fewer rights than we did. We cannot go backward. I will never hesitate to do what is right in the U.S. Senate — justice for the people will be my North Star.
\- Cheri Beasley

subject: Home for the holidays?
body:

Dear Friends,
It’s almost time for many of us to welcome our adult children home for the holidays. This is a treasured time of year for me, as all five of mine are living in various parts of the country. It feels like year after year, many of my friends and neighbors with adult children are either moving to be closer to their kids and some are **resigning themselves to the fact that their children will not be****returning to CT****to raise their families.**
The fact is that Connecticut has not only become less affordable in the last two decades for those still living here, but also less of a financial option for our children to come home after college, or stay home to build their lives closer to family and friends. (Unless they are coming home to live with their parents.)
My opponent may point to the numbers of New Yorkers who moved in during the pandemic, but let’s face it – they fled the city because of lockdowns and safety concerns. **CT has still not recovered jobs lost from the Great Recession and we are entering another recession due to the failed economic policies my opponent voted to pass. We need to make it affordable for everyone in CT to stop the net out migration from CT.** My opponent has not proposed or supported any bills to bring back the state and local tax (SALT) deductions.
**Property owners pay for local infrastructure costs and these benefits should be recognized to allow these deductions again.** We need less regulations on businesses to promote a more diverse economy, and to alleviate the constant traffic and ever increasing commute times on MetroNorth.
We need to do all we can to create a thriving environment that encourages our younger generations to come back home.

clean_body: | | | | It feels like year after year, many of my friends and neighbors with adult children are either moving to be closer to their kids and some are resigning themselves to the fact that their children will not be returning to CT to raise their families. jaymestevensonforcongress.com Dear Friends, It’s almost time for many of us to welcome our adult children home for the holidays. This is a treasured time of year for me, as all five of mine are living in various parts of the country. It feels like year after year, many of my friends and neighbors with adult children are either moving to be closer to their kids and some are resigning themselves to the fact that their children will not bereturning to CTto raise their families. The fact is that Connecticut has not only become less affordable in the last two decades for those still living here, but also less of a financial option for our children to come home after college, or stay home to build their lives closer to family and friends. (Unless they are coming home to live with their parents.) My opponent may point to the numbers of New Yorkers who moved in during the pandemic, but let’s face it – they fled the city because of lockdowns and safety concerns. CT has still not recovered jobs lost from the Great Recession and we are entering another recession due to the failed economic policies my opponent voted to pass. We need to make it affordable for everyone in CT to stop the net out migration from CT. My opponent has not proposed or supported any bills to bring back the state and local tax (SALT) deductions. Property owners pay for local infrastructure costs and these benefits should be recognized to allow these deductions again. We need less regulations on businesses to promote a more diverse economy, and to alleviate the constant traffic and ever increasing commute times on MetroNorth. We need to do all we can to create a thriving environment that encourages our younger generations to come back home. It’s time to change the direction of this state. It’s time for a more affordable Connecticut. It’s time for government leaders to help set the stage for our kids to feel secure that they can come home and make a good life here in Connecticut. Volunteers needed: POLL WORKERS AND PHONE BANKERS NEEDED! It ALL matters & we can’t do it without you! My family, children, and I thank you for your continued support! Jayme Stevenson Candidate for Congress, District 4 Connecticut | | ABOUT JAYME I’m running for Congress to bring common sense and balance back to Washington and to give voice to the people of the 4th Congressional District who have been left behind by politicians working for themselves and a national party agenda. As a trusted leader and mother of five children, I understand the impacts government policies have on our communities and promise to fight for Connecticut children, families and businesses. | "Facebook" | "Twitter" | "Instagram" ---|---|--- Jayme Stevenson 1326 Post Road, Fairfield, 06824

| | Peter I know you’re getting tired of getting campaign emails.

_Trust me, I’m tired of writing them, so I’ll make this quick._

Joe Biden has destroyed our economy, shut down our energy industry, and weakened our nation on the world stage. When I am elected, I will hold him accountable. Together we will take our country back and restore the American Dream. The days of career politicians, warmongerers, and the DC elite are over. On November 9th, the real work begins. Thank you, Harriet Hageman | | | | |

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

clean_body: I wouldn’t be reaching out to you so frantically if this wasn’t a dire situation... | | Fellow American, I wouldn’t be reaching out to you so frantically if this wasn’t a dire situation ... but my Democrat-endorsed opponent is outraising my campaign and we’re days away from Election Day. Now is not the time to fall behind - too much is at stake in this election for us to lose. I called my team and asked them what I can do to pick up the pace. Their response? REACH OUT TO YOU, Fellow American. If I win – Republicans will win back the Senate majority. If I lose - well, you know. We can’t let that happen. The Democrats are determined to win in Utah. Chuck Schumer knows a WIN here is the ONLY WAY the left can hold their majority. My campaign is being outraised and time is running out before Election Day. This is the time when critical ad placements are made and without money in the bank - my opponent will be able to reach more voters at a crucial stage in this race. Help me win and help Republicans take back the Senate majority. I’m counting on hearing from you. For America, Mike Lee MEET MIKE: | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property. After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court. Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah. | | | ---|---|--- | Paid for by Friends of Mike Lee, Inc. PO Box 1537 Salt Lake City, UT 84110

Team,
With just 4 days to go until Election Day, we’re sure your inbox is out-of-control with emails from candidates and groups all telling you about the importance of November 8th. We know, we’ve also been emailing you quite a bit lately, so today we thought we would explain why.
Your help in these final four days is still critically important. In this final stretch, every dollar that comes in the door is funding one thing: voter contact.
We currently have 8 staging locations setup throughout the new district that will serve as hubs for our staff and volunteers to knock doors, make calls, and send text messages to voters to make sure they get to the polls. There’s also our Michigan State University program, where our student organizers will be making sure their fellow students have a plan to get to the polls.
This final massive Get Out the Vote push is why continuing to have money coming in the door these last few days is so important. Anything we make goes immediately back out the door into everything needed to make these staging locations function. Often it goes to things you may not immediately think of, like convincing college students to give up their weekend with the promise of free pizza.
Want to help us out? Send $20 our way to buy some dedicated MSU organizers some pizza. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221105_1&amount=28] They’ll be very grateful!

| | | | | **Cliff’s Note:** **Per _CBS News_ polling, "If November’s election sees a big turnout of young voters and voters of color...the Battleground Tracker predicts Democrats hold onto the majority by a single seat..." If not, we lose 10-15 seats, and the House, where Marjorie Taylor Greene will promptly push for Joe Biden's impeachment. _We can't let this happen_. Like the Kansas abortion referendum, younger voters will determine if it does. Please keep this in mind as you read Mark Hamill's urgent plea below to support _Voters of Tomorrow_ , as they register every last voter in states like Colorado--where Lauren Boebert's in danger of losing her seat--that allow voter registration through Election Day. ** [](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tfaed6734-ad40-4180-a6fe-273c918403ba/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Dear Peter, **Voters of Tomorrow, has a simple plan: Educate, register, and mobilize young voters so they can have a voice in the next election. Younger voters HAVE ALREADY MADE THE DIFFERENCE THIS ELECTION. The record-breaking turnout among younger voters and women in Kansas is credited with destroying a Death Star in Kansas, the referendum attempting to ban all abortion. With its defeat by a whopping 18%, I think we can successfully say that Death Star was destroyed.** **_But if we know anything about Death Stars--and the Right Wing in this country--they're always building more._** I'm not saying any of this to be dramatic, I save that for onscreen. This is for real. They're trying to take away our rights--to choose, whom to love, what books our kids read, the safety of our children inside schools and outside in our climate--RIGHT NOW. Without high turnout from young voters, the fate of our future will be sealed. **_So with the 2022 midterm election only 3 days away, Voters of Tomorrow's voter registration efforts are more important than ever. They will register every last voter, which in some states continues right up through election day._** Registering one new voter costs $4.38, and they're still hoping to register more than 5,000 new voters by the election - that’s $21,900! [**So today, I'm asking you to chip in $22 to help fund their General Election Fund so they can ramp up voter registration efforts. Can you rush a donation right now?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T85a424be-e1b4-4093-bf8d-9176239f6753/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) **A $22 donation = FIVE new voters registered! $44 and they can register TEN NEW VOTERS! | | How a “fiercely independent” political underdog is winning over voters left and right NORTHERN, Mich. — Over 300 campaign events in a year. Thirty-six counties. Over 50,000 miles on the campaign trail. Nearly 450,000 likely voters. What will it take to flip Michigan's 1st District? Dr. Bob Lorinser (D, MI1) intends to find out.
"Make no mistake. To win, we need to work hard to get our message out," says Dr. Lorinser. "If we maintain momentum, hit our fundraising goals, and continue to garner grassroots support from people of all walks of life, this will be one of the most exciting races in Michigan, if not the country."
Large corporations, PACs, and dark money fund incumbent Rep. Jack Bergman's campaign, unlike Dr. Bob's individual contributors from voters in the District. Lorinser is inevitably out-funded, but not by much. "We have momentum, and [Bergman] does not," says Dr. Bob. "I'm counting on increased voter turnout and the galvanization of voters ready for change. By myself, I won't win, but together, we will. Our grassroots campaign is successful because of the generosity of citizens who believe in democracy, honesty, and integrity." Lorinser says he's not interested in pulling the District to the left or the right. "I intend to lead us forward," he says. "I want my grandchildren to be proud that we won by fighting for universal values and supporting what's best for all Yoopers and Northern Michiganders." Winning Variables Although Democrats outnumber Republicans by 10% (45% vs 35% with 20% Independents), since 2012 Democratic candidates have been outvoted by a similar margin. Lorinser says it's time to return to Rep. Bart Stupak's 18 years of service when Democrats had a 10-point advantage. Lorinser believes he's the right candidate at the right time to recapture the difference by rallying his base, appealing to independents, and offering conservatives a better alternative to dishonesty and division. Early voting data and internal polling shows Lorinser could benefit from a 22 pt. advantage compared to 2020. "Bergman has doubled down on his involvement in the Jan. 6 insurrection," said Lorinser.. “Voters are yearning for honesty in politics, and my opponent has lost a lot of credibility and trust."
Lorinser's credentials and reputation have earned him enthusiastic support from state officials and organizing committees, attracting some of the best field operatives, firms, and political experts in the Midwest. Dr. Bob's campaign manager, Kevin Numerick, has turned around races by more significant deficits in similar districts across the country. "Dr. Bob's opponent is spending hundreds of thousands of tax-payer dollars on misleading self-promotional mailers," said Numerick. "They may have an unethical windfall of money, but we have hundreds of volunteer canvassers putting in long hours, letting voters know there's a much better option on the ballot this year."
Every week, Dr. Bob's team has tens of thousands of meaningful conversations with all kinds of voters, from liberals to conservatives and everyone in between.
"We are still the underdog," admits Dr. Lorinser. "But, every hardworking 1st District resident knows that's exactly the fuel needed to surmount big obstacles. Through Northern Michigan and UP grit, my goal is to earn voters' respect and trust." Lorinser says he's confident he'll also earn the necessary votes to make history and flip the seat "if voters have a fair opportunity to compare me with my opponent." "I want every voter to evaluate the character, principles, qualifications, and positions of who they vote for,” says Dr. Bob. “When they do, I think we stand a good chance of winning. That is why Bergman refuses to publicly debate. It will be the honor of my life to serve Northern Michigan and the Upper Peninsula in the US House of Representatives." body:
Erik's OpEd in Campfire Colorado
| | | |

---
|
# Who is the real extremist in CD7?
---
|
---
|
---
| | |
---|---
|
Who is the real extremist in the seventh district congressional race?
Brittany Pettersen portrays herself as a moderate while allowing her high-dollar media team to levy baseless accusations against me. But despite these efforts, her voting record and policy positions reveal her unsettling and destructive radicalism.
In contrast, I stand for balanced and responsible governance that puts party aside to get things done for Colorado and America.
| | |
---|---
|
Brittany Pettersen voted to lower penalties for possessing lethal amounts of fentanyl. What has followed is an unprecedented number of deaths (approaching 1500 in Colorado alone), mostly young people, from the drug. Many users do not realize that they are taking fentanyl. Chinese agencies manufacture this dangerous drug and provide it to cartels who transport it across the southern border to flood the American streets. It is a carefully designed, heinous attack on our country.
We must not tolerate this lawlessness. As a Congressman, I will strive to ensure our laws are enforced and drug dealers are held accountable for their crimes. Whereas Joe Biden and Nancy Pelosi have left the southern border open (and Brittany Pettersen agrees with that) a secure southern border is key to restoring public safety and national security.
| | |
---|---
|
Brittany Pettersen has no answers for meeting our future energy needs. She has only the ideologically driven, naive intent to abruptly move away from oil and natural gas and switch to intermittent solar and wind power prematurely. This extreme and dangerous path would be disastrous to our economy and undermine our national security.
Any energy expert will acknowledge the continuing need for oil and natural gas in the short to medium term, and that increased natural gas utilization has had the greatest impact on reducing harmful emissions. The Biden administration's destruction of domestic oil and natural gas production has made us reliant on hostile foreign sources, jeopardized our national security, and contributed to nearly doubling the cost of fuel products over two years.
| |
---|---
|
There is a better way. Having spent a decade working all over the world in the energy sector, I understand how to establish sustainable energy independence for our nation. We must protect our environment while restoring sound energy policy. If we steward our natural resources responsibly, we can seek sustainability without diminishing national security, the economy, living standards, or global power and competitive advantage. Wise use of existing sources of energy, coupled with well-researched, market-proven emerging technologies, will enhance lifestyles for everyone while preserving our planet for future generations.
| | |
---|---
|
Brittany Pettersen sees increasing taxes on fuel as being a beneficial use of government power, even though this added cost during an economic downturn hurts every citizen in the state. In addition, she has no response to the malaise besetting our economy except to increase government spending, in spite of the fact that excessive spending is exactly what has caused today's inflation crisis. She clearly supports increasing this insidious hidden tax on the American people.
I will seek to end wasteful federal spending from day one in office. I believe Congress must carefully manage government spending with a consistent view towards reducing costs and waste.

Furthermore, I will lead in returning government to its proper role as designed by the Constitution. It is not the role of government to live our lives and make our decisions for us. The enormous success of our nation comes from opportunity and freedom to pursue one's dreams.
| | |
---|---
|
Brittany Pettersen is too extreme for Colorado and for the country. Despite her hollow claims of being a "fighter" for citizens, she will only fall in line with her Washington bosses. We do not need another rubber stamp for the destruction of opportunity and the erosion of the rule of law.
If you want to restore balance and responsibility to our government, I would be honored to have your vote. I am a proven leader in combat and business. I bring experience that a career politician like Brittany Pettersen simply does not possess. In all of our policy challenges, I am well prepared to seek that precious middle point between right and left to find the answer that best serves each individual, promotes harmony and respect between us, and preserves our beloved liberty.
|
---
| Erik Aadland is a candidate for Congress in Colorado's 7th Congressional District. He is a husband, father, combat veteran, and businessman. clean_body: Erik's OpEd in Campfire Colorado | | | | | Who is the real extremist in CD7? | | | | | ---|--- | Who is the real extremist in the seventh district congressional race? Brittany Pettersen portrays herself as a moderate while allowing her high-dollar media team to levy baseless accusations against me. But despite these efforts, her voting record and policy positions reveal her unsettling and destructive radicalism. In contrast, I stand for balanced and responsible governance that puts party aside to get things done for Colorado and America. | | | ---|--- | Brittany Pettersen voted to lower penalties for possessing lethal amounts of fentanyl. What has followed is an unprecedented number of deaths (approaching 1500 in Colorado alone), mostly young people, from the drug. Many users do not realize that they are taking fentanyl. Chinese agencies manufacture this dangerous drug and provide it to cartels who transport it across the southern border to flood the American streets. It is a carefully designed, heinous attack on our country. We must not tolerate this lawlessness. As a Congressman, I will strive to ensure our laws are enforced and drug dealers are held accountable for their crimes. Whereas Joe Biden and Nancy Pelosi have left the southern border open (and Brittany Pettersen agrees with that) a secure southern border is key to restoring public safety and national security. | | | ---|--- | Brittany Pettersen has no answers for meeting our future energy needs. She has only the ideologically driven, naive intent to abruptly move away from oil and natural gas and switch to intermittent solar and wind power prematurely. This extreme and dangerous path would be disastrous to our economy and undermine our national security. Any energy expert will acknowledge the continuing need for oil and natural gas in the short to medium term, and that increased natural gas utilization has had the greatest impact on reducing harmful emissions. The Biden administration's destruction of domestic oil and natural gas production has made us reliant on hostile foreign sources, jeopardized our national security, and contributed to nearly doubling the cost of fuel products over two years. | | ---|--- | There is a better way. Having spent a decade working all over the world in the energy sector, I understand how to establish sustainable energy independence for our nation. We must protect our environment while restoring sound energy policy. If we steward our natural resources responsibly, we can seek sustainability without diminishing national security, the economy, living standards, or global power and competitive advantage. Wise use of existing sources of energy, coupled with well-researched, market-proven emerging technologies, will enhance lifestyles for everyone while preserving our planet for future generations. | | | ---|--- | Brittany Pettersen sees increasing taxes on fuel as being a beneficial use of government power, even though this added cost during an economic downturn hurts every citizen in the state. In addition, she has no response to the malaise besetting our economy except to increase government spending, in spite of the fact that excessive spending is exactly what has caused today's inflation crisis. She clearly supports increasing this insidious hidden tax on the American people. I will seek to end wasteful federal spending from day one in office. I believe Congress must carefully manage government spending with a consistent view towards reducing costs and waste. Furthermore, I will lead in returning government to its proper role as designed by the Constitution. It is not the role of government to live our lives and make our decisions for us. The enormous success of our nation comes from opportunity and freedom to pursue one's dreams. | | | ---|--- | Brittany Pettersen is too extreme for Colorado and for the country. Despite her hollow claims of being a "fighter" for citizens, she will only fall in line with her Washington bosses. We do not need another rubber stamp for the destruction of opportunity and the erosion of the rule of law. If you want to restore balance and responsibility to our government, I would be honored to have your vote. I am a proven leader in combat and business. I bring experience that a career politician like Brittany Pettersen simply does not possess. In all of our policy challenges, I am well prepared to seek that precious middle point between right and left to find the answer that best serves each individual, promotes harmony and respect between us, and preserves our beloved liberty. | | Erik Aadland is a candidate for Congress in Colorado's 7th Congressional District. body:
Alexandria is facing off with a MAGA Republican on Tuesday.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20221105-3582-header&t=1&akid=3582%2E2526796%2E_KaNle)
Alexandria understands the importance of Tuesday’s election, and growing our progressive power up and down the ballot. So for the last few months, our movement has invested time, energy, and fundraising power to help candidates — like newcomer Summer Lee, and Squad members Rashida Tlaib, Cori Bush, and Jamaal Bowman — win their primaries. Not only that, Team AOC has invested organizing power across NYC for local candidates.
**But while Alexandria was safe in her primary election, the reality is we have to take our MAGA, insurrectionist Republican challenger seriously in this Tuesday's general election.**
We need to make sure we do everything we can to reelect Alexandria and keep our progressive power rooted in NY-14. **That’s why we set a fundraising goal of $15,000 before Election Day, and why we’re emailing you now.**
[With just three days left before our election, can we count on you to make your first donation of any amount to get us to our $15,000 fundraising goal today?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20221105.tRl_Rt&refcode=em20221105-3582-P_FND_EGR_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3582%2E2526796%2E_KaNle)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20221105.tRl_Rt&refcode=em20221105-3582-P_FND_EGR_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=3582%2E2526796%2E_KaNle)**
Last year, our Republican opponent raised $10 million against us. And the entire Republican establishment and their corporate allies put the full weight of their propaganda machine into spreading lies about Alexandria.
**This year, Alexandria’s MAGA opponent is running an aggressive race.** They hosted multiple $500-dollar-a-plate fundraising dinners around the country, set up a massive #OustAOC sign on a highway overpass in Queens, and are encouraging anti-vax, MAGA hecklers to harass constituents at events intended to be apolitical, civic functions.
**We need to push back by continuing to forge real connections with the communities in The Bronx and Queens that support Alexandria’s message.** And that’s why we’re counting on you now.
[Please, if you can, make your first contribution of any amount today to help us fight back and reach our $15,000 fundraising goal before our deadline on Election Day.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20221105.tRl_Rt&refcode=em20221105-3582-P_FND_EGR_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=3582%2E2526796%2E_KaNle)
When we won the second most expensive House race in the country — that sent a signal to Democrats and Republicans. We were able to pass the biggest investment in climate change ever, student loan debt relief, and gun control. **Now, with reproductive freedom and so much else on the line, we can’t afford to look weak.**
Thank you for standing with us,
Team AOC

Friends –
I've spent more than four decades making films that tell America’s stories, and examining the crises – internal and external – that we have faced as a nation, including threats to our democracy.
From the Civil War to the Great Depression, from the First and Second World Wars to the COVID-19 pandemic, these crises have challenged us to live up to the essential promise of our nation, preserving a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.
Today, challenges to our republic are rampant, the democratic values that make up the very fabric of our nation are under assault and at risk of unraveling. It’s never been more important to safeguard our fragile democracy: as Benjamin Franklin so wisely put it, "A Republic, if you can keep it."
That’s why I’m reaching out. With a 50-50 split in the Senate, the fate of our Democratic majority—and our very democracy—hinges on what happens in New Hampshire.
Maggie Hassan is a vital voice in the Senate, and we cannot afford to lose her tireless work on behalf of Granite Staters—and in fact _all_ Americans. Next week, she's up against a far-right election denier who believes a woman’s most personal decisions about abortion—decisions about her own body—belong in the hands of Republican “gentlemen” lawmakers.
Our country stands at a crossroads, and it's up to us to decide which direction we’ll take. Either we plunge down the path of extremism that Maggie's opponent has taken, or we choose the other way—the higher road—and come together to support leaders like Maggie who will fight to protect our future.
Maggie won her last race by just 1,017 votes. That was one of the closest margins in American history. And Republicans are targeting her race with more than $60 million in attack ads. With just three days left until the election, we need to have the resources necessary to turn out every last vote.

subject: There is no other place on the planet like Texas

body:
There is no other place on the planet like Texas. There’s just something
really exceptional and extraordinary about those of us who live here.

But under Greg Abbott, we are losing the big, bold vision that used to
define Texas, a Texas big enough for all of us. Big enough for our dreams
and big enough to make them happen. We’ve been offered something small,
mean, and uninspiring in its place.

But it doesn’t have to be this way.

I want us to rise to our full promise in this state.
I see this campaign as an
opportunity for us to come through as Texans who want to get back to doing
big things — and get back to doing them together.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20221105-2.85n5Ym&refcode=ema20221105-216058&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=216058%2E444211%2ETjpWNx ]With only days left before the election, I hope you will help me with a
contribution to ensure I have the resources to win the most important
governor's race in America this year.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20221105-2.85n5Ym&refcode=ema20221105-216058&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&akid=216058%2E444211%2ETjpWNx ]Contribute $3

Nearly 10 years after the Shelby decision, it is harder to vote in the
state of Texas than any other state in the union, harder to get
registered, and harder to get your name on the rolls than anywhere else in
America.

Greg Abbott's extreme abortion ban that begins at conception — with no
exception for rape or incest — exacerbates a maternal mortality crisis in
Texas that’s three times as deadly for Black women.

And after each mass shooting in Texas, Abbott has promised solutions but
provided none. In fact, he’s made it easier for criminals to carry guns on
our streets, and he has set the stage for more tragedies like Uvalde,
Midland-Odessa, El Paso, Santa Fe, and Sutherland Springs.

As dark as these days are, I really do think it’s going to bring out the
very best in us. Folks who may consider themselves Independents or
Republicans or who never, ever, ever thought about voting before are not
going to miss this election because their lives are riding on the outcome.

I just know that we will
turn a page on Greg Abbott’s failures, overcome his extremism, and move
Texas forward. [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20221105-2.85n5Ym&refcode=ema20221105-216058&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=216058%2E444211%2ETjpWNx ]But I need your help to finish these last three days
strong. Will you make a contribution today?

We’re made of bigger and stronger things than what you see today.
Together, we will deliver for one another and this state.

Thank you,

Beto

name: Candace Owens
subject: Proof that Hollywood is Satanic
body:
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61803333:J_tUJ8GN8:m:1:3372944669:2665378999432838723ED6A93D2AEF67:r)
Peter,

Would you believe me if I said that a mother watched videos of her daughter having sex with her boyfriend and picked which one her daughter looked best in to **sell?**

Because that's exactly what happened -- Kris Jenner watched AND hand-picked which sex tape her daughter Kim Kardashian would release!

**It is not an exaggeration to say that Hollywood is satanic.**
What could possibly be more satanic than a mother using her daughter's body to sell sex?

If that disgusts you, here's where it gets worse. _It worked_. Kim Kardashian is a billionaire, and she's still selling sex.

She is symbolic of the society we live in today. That if you are willing to degrade yourself, if you're willing to denigrate yourself, then our society will give you more.

**Is this the example we want to leave for our children?**

At BLEXIT, we believe families should be grounded in faith and honor and respect their children and protect their innocence.

My name is Candace Owens, co-founder of the BLEXIT Foundation. BLEXIT focuses on educating minorities about the history of our great country, the principles of the Constitution, and the importance of self-reliance.

I've set a goal to raise $50,000 by the end of the month to show the next generation that they don't have to be like the Kardashians to be successful.

[**Can you support this critical mission with a gift of $25, $35, or even $50? Click here to donate today >>>**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61803333:J_tUJ8GN8:m:1:3372944669:2665378999432838723ED6A93D2AEF67:r)

BLEXIT is bringing pro-America, pro-Family values to Black and minority communities through the work of our State Chapters.

Our Chapters spread the universal principles of the BLEXIT movement at the local level through community service, social engagement, educational activities, and virtual events.

They demonstrate how people can escape the mentality of victimhood and empower others to take control of their destinies.

Just this summer, **BLEXIT-Fest in New Jersey introduced our message to over 400 people.** They had a variety of talented performers and speakers and created a memorable community celebration.

**BLEXIT chapter members from our Tampa, FL, and North Charleston, SC sites educated and cared for approximately 80 children** for six weeks during our full-day Summer Camp.

The children in our Tampa program even took a field trip to Legoland!

Now that school has started, these BLEXIT chapters are providing an after-school youth education program - Liberation Camp - for 80 children.

_BLEXIT 's Chapters are a huge part of our Back to School initiative_.

The BLEXIT Illinois Chapter **distributed over 400 school supplies** and BLEXIT merchandise in one of Chicago's most impoverished communities. The NY Chapter was fortunate to **give away 120 school supply kits as well as 40 book bags.**

BLEXIT Chapters are changing the narrative that surrounds America's minority communities.

[**We currently have 42 chapters across the US and more than 14,000 volunteers! You can help BLEXIT support our State Chapters by donating $25, $35, $50, or any other amount today. Click here to send your gift >>>**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61803333:J_tUJ8GN8:m:1:3372944669:2665378999432838723ED6A93D2AEF67:r)

BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence reinforced by groups that market themselves as serving the Black community, such as Black Lives Matter, but in actuality, they destroy communities.

These organizations are poisoning minority communities. They tell these bright young men and women they are victims of systematic repression and that their skin color is all that defines them.

But here's the ugly truth about other organizations who claim to serve the Black community:

* They claim to support Black communities. . . but they fan the flames of riots and violence that directly impact the lives of the people in those communities.

* They claim to fight for criminal justice reform. . . but they teach Black men and women to hate and disrespect police officers.

* They claim to be a non-profit group fighting for Black men and women. . . but they use donor funds to enrich themselves.

**These other organizations are destroying Black communities, dividing our country, and forcing a message of victimhood and hatred down the throats of minorities.**

BLEXIT is countering their hateful narrative, but we can't do it alone, Peter. Can you donate to BLEXIT today and help us reach our goal of raising $50,000?

I've set a goal to raise $50,000 by the end of the month to show the next generation that they don't have to be like the Kardashians to be successful. BLEXIT is bringing pro-America, pro-Family values to Black and minority communities through the work of our State Chapters. Our Chapters spread the universal principles of the BLEXIT movement at the local level through community service, social engagement, educational activities, and virtual events. They demonstrate how people can escape the mentality of victimhood and empower others to take control of their destinies. Just this summer, BLEXIT-Fest in New Jersey introduced our message to over 400 people. They had a variety of talented performers and speakers and created a memorable community celebration. BLEXIT chapter members from our Tampa, FL, and North Charleston, SC sites educated and cared for approximately 80 children for six weeks during our full-day Summer Camp. The children in our Tampa program even took a field trip to Legoland! Now that school has started, these BLEXIT chapters are providing an after-school youth education program - Liberation Camp - for 80 children. BLEXIT 's Chapters are a huge part of our Back to School initiative. The BLEXIT Illinois Chapter distributed over 400 school supplies and BLEXIT merchandise in one of Chicago's most impoverished communities. The NY Chapter was fortunate to give away 120 school supply kits as well as 40 book bags. BLEXIT Chapters are changing the narrative that surrounds America's minority communities. BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence reinforced by groups that market themselves as serving the Black community, such as Black Lives Matter, but in actuality, they destroy communities. These organizations are poisoning minority communities. They tell these bright young men and women they are victims of systematic repression and that their skin color is all that defines them. But here's the ugly truth about other organizations who claim to serve the Black community: They claim to support Black communities. . . but they fan the flames of riots and violence that directly impact the lives of the people in those communities. They claim to fight for criminal justice reform. . . but they teach Black men and women to hate and disrespect police officers. They claim to be a non-profit group fighting for Black men and women. . . but they use donor funds to enrich themselves. These other organizations are destroying Black communities, dividing our country, and forcing a message of victimhood and hatred down the throats of minorities.** BLEXIT is countering their hateful narrative, but we can't do it alone, Peter. Can you donate to BLEXIT today and help us reach our goal of raising $50,000? Thank you, Candace Owens Co-Founder & President BLEXIT Foundation BLEXIT is a 501(c)3 tax-exempt organization. subject: The Biden Regime Must Be Stopped
body:
From declaring war on American energy to opening our southern border and rolling out the red carpet...| | | [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=1b4e9625be2a4061b43b831c31fb78eb&_e=vxfmks-Rkp7DuVNlo30dHdfvophY9QcFbWYxEDtv564F7jla-yBIE0Hh5-AnTr_Qmve0oIRA8xszmVnWfpX-Af28PR5PHK0OCTl3NaVdr9k3Pv5pZhIq8B4ziPq2pckk-ZdS85m_zUtwj61XaqUZn6tUJILvykha11qeXo1BGBAJ81lhW8V2ooB4jUd2ShObGK13pktt0e65AS2BfWa2fqLRlakmN7cyqh8m1eCdTktORdnr-qtKNkFBfWmAsx2sJ3LvoCDnNSlWcUdmAJFeZL0m3E7grWy4wrd0lSJjwOA_8AVjs0_QYscLdkJP7ONMBpvox0mig_UxwewkoQPvPdT16lkL57hQCi-Y65OiP6Q%3D)
---
Peter, Joe Biden and the Democrat Machine are a danger to Florida. From the moment he stepped into the Oval Office, Joe Biden has harmed our country at every turn. From declaring war on American energy to opening our southern border and rolling out the red carpet for human smugglers and dangerous drugs, to backing woke demands to implement soft-on-crime policies, to all-out attacks on parental rights, _**Joe Biden has failed the American people.**__****_ [**STOP THE BIDEN REGIME** ](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=1b4e9625be2a4061b43b831c31fb78eb&_e=vxfmks-Rkp7DuVNlo30dHdfvophY9QcFbWYxEDtv564F7jla-yBIE0Hh5-AnTr_Qmve0oIRA8xszmVnWfpX-Af28PR5PHK0OCTl3NaVdr9k3Pv5pZhIq8B4ziPq2pckk-ZdS85m_zUtwj61XaqUZn6tUJILvykha11qeXo1BGBAJ81lhW8V2ooB4jUd2ShOb1GLka1LZOjsTkJmjSdRWhzFG7YavRGDOD_dbR-nKolQwpPJSQ2XTOj2LQPnvu0WaGwym5BBOlSL-YKOA6XgZnedfqLsFtW_O0EZgVjN9lUutOYBi3LNj7xE6XBZDoUSVbErtyrUsUiOIhg_zhB823QvaW9edZrcfWL8QT14DuyE%3D) The Biden Regime’s policies have been disastrous for our country, yet instead of correcting course and doing his job, Biden spends his time enjoying beachside vacations and giving speeches that undoubtedly start with a teleprompter gaffe and end with him getting lost trying to step off the stage. You’d think the complete disaster this presidency has been thus far would motivate the Regime to get to work to create solutions for the problems they have caused, but that would mirror real leadership too closely for this gang of grifters. No, instead, as Americans continue on the dark and twisted path our country is being led down, the Biden administration is focusing on more “important” work, like inviting TikTok stars to the White House and hosting Elton John concerts on the White House lawn. Their failures are hurting the American people — but they don’t care because they’re not in office to better the lives of the people they serve. Their only concerns are what best serves their own selfish interests. [**KEEP BIDEN’S POLICIES OUT OF FLORIDA** ](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=1b4e9625be2a4061b43b831c31fb78eb&_e=vxfmks-Rkp7DuVNlo30dHdfvophY9QcFbWYxEDtv564F7jla-yBIE0Hh5-AnTr_Qmve0oIRA8xszmVnWfpX-Af28PR5PHK0OCTl3NaVdr9k3Pv5pZhIq8B4ziPq2pckk-ZdS85m_zUtwj61XaqUZn6tUJILvykha11qeXo1BGBAJ81lhW8V2ooB4jUd2ShObHeX6iuYTyRvx7PkVK6_YHbs0rnIU1O3mgFZJy_2QmXv1QdaG1wukeTxefFPHx_QRblpTKG-LXGM59P75swmh71tM1qiXlYDdqdUQ9XWAl_YbzPkVOyA1VoYtWKxbRIm0DA2PkMtZ_ymAOVsJLPCWC8M2aBm15uI_zauTq66Og44%3D) I’ve worked tirelessly to keep the Biden Regime’s disastrous policies out of Florida — **but now, the Democrat Machine is working to take control of our state.****** Make no mistake, Peter, if the Democrat Machine takes control of our state, their only plan is to hand the keys over to the Biden administration and allow the Regime to do to Florida what they’ve already done to the rest of the country. [_**Rush in your immediate donation to keep the Democrat Machine out of Florida. >>>**_ ](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=1b4e9625be2a4061b43b831c31fb78eb&_e=vxfmks-Rkp7DuVNlo30dHdfvophY9QcFbWYxEDtv564F7jla-yBIE0Hh5-AnTr_Qmve0oIRA8xszmVnWfpX-Af28PR5PHK0OCTl3NaVdr9k3Pv5pZhIq8B4ziPq2pckk-ZdS85m_zUtwj61XaqUZn6tUJILvykha11qeXo1BGBAJ81lhW8V2ooB4jUd2ShObhR8iSH2brYCsKWPVo5qqS1uD06LGif_6XFKG7B-NC_hDQ8M2FeONIlKduA7DD5M13ZguYBlmZtVhnlitkaw-8pNdgwhbDegBQzJzDD7Z8sSuQZQ3BdQ96IjjvJ0Hbq4cZ-hDoIL4Wdgv8DwD5X0PDGslw69XcO3iZ7IggeRqkEY%3D) I’m working around the clock to make sure that doesn’t happen, but I need your help. Your help has never been more important than it is right now. I cannot do this without freedom fighters like you. Your action today could be the difference between a free Florida or a Florida plagued by the same policies that are destroying blue states from the inside out. Don’t let the far-Left win, Peter. [_**Take a stand to keep the Left’s extreme agenda out of Florida by sending your donation TODAY! >>>**_ ](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=1b4e9625be2a4061b43b831c31fb78eb&_e=vxfmks-Rkp7DuVNlo30dHdfvophY9QcFbWYxEDtv564F7jla-yBIE0Hh5-AnTr_Qmve0oIRA8xszmVnWfpX-Af28PR5PHK0OCTl3NaVdr9k3Pv5pZhIq8B4ziPq2pckk-ZdS85m_zUtwj61XaqUZn6tUJILvykha11qeXo1BGBAJ81lhW8V2ooB4jUd2ShObLs3KtUP77Yek-r2Z0mHoamLITGA4e-abdRe-n9ypppcSAurH3g2bzzhf0rfgrwji3i-xEwUg98cQ_q_7s1nqTf7RyDtu4vZQCPupiCAHjY0IaStk24l1vdemHLKP9Ht0y5vtLvs8RO2FSnH1voYnqOg-tRd-5VnP802dkgiwdMQ%3D) Thank you for stepping up,__

**Growing up in a working family in Brooklyn meant that I didn’t have much power or privilege. **

I had no special strings to tug on and no way to stop manipulative landlords, predatory lenders, and powerful corporations from taking advantage of families like my own. **But when I made history in 2018 by becoming the first Black woman ever to serve as New York’s attorney general, I vowed to finally bring these bad actors to justice. **
Peter, from the moment I first took office, I have done _everything_ I could to hold the powerful and corrupt accountable – and already, we’ve been able to make a _real_ difference for working families both in New York and beyond. But, at a moment when so many fundamental rights are being attacked, my work is NOWHERE near complete.

**That’s why I’m running for re-election for attorney general, but I sincerely can’t do this without your help. Because, to be frank, we can't take _anything_ ****in this race for granted –** **especially now that my GOP opponent is GAINING significant ground in the polls. **

Peter, I’ve always known that, as a Black woman, nothing in life is guaranteed – and that includes this race. body:
| | | Friend, the closer we get to Election Day, the more worried I am about the Supreme Court. The possibility of Mitch McConnell being in charge again is terrifying on so many levels.

Donald Trump’s ultra-conservative justices seem to be ruling with a personal mission to strip us of our most basic freedoms. They gutted part of the Voting Rights Act and, by overturning _Roe v. Wade,_ they took away a right my generation fought hard for and WON in 1973. And now they're going after the Voting Rights Act AGAIN!

We cannot let Mitch McConnell control any more seats on our highest court. Our only chance to restore some balance is by expanding our Democratic Senate majority!

| | | | | Peter, **_[I'd like to provide you with The Closing Argument of this election](https://default.salsalabs.org/Te27adb86-5122-4ad4-b64e-8d3ff8426462/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)._** IT IS THAT JOE BIDEN HAS BEEN ONE OF THE MOST SUCCESSFUL AND CONSEQUENTIAL PRESIDENTS OF OUR LIFETIMES, AND ALONG WITH A DEMOCRATIC CONGRESS WE MUST HOLD, HAS A RECORD THAT MATCHES ANY ADMINISTRATION IN THE PAST 100 YEARS. **_[I MADE A SHORT VIDEO SHARING JUST THE KEY FACTS THAT MAKE THIS CASE--EASILY THE MOST IMPORTANT VIDEO I'VE EVER MADE--AND I AM NOW ASKING YOU TO WATCH IT, SHARE IT WITH EVERYONE YOU KNOW](https://default.salsalabs.org/T0936a5c5-1114-4ade-bc09-1cf17c9394da/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), AND [SUBSCRIBE TO THE CHANNEL](https://default.salsalabs.org/T29cf3ab7-d4e4-45c5-82b2-fefa6550484a/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), ["THE TAKEDOWN w/ CLIFF SCHECTER.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb5396c64-d197-4eb5-bf0e-3066d5deeb22/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)_** **This list--this community--is so filled with rock stars that I couldn't be more proud to communicate with you all every day, to get to know many of you and have your support for great causes and candidates we promote here. ** **_We have shared videos, apps, petitions & other items we've thought would be of interest to you_._ Post-election, we plan to do much more of this!_** **_[PLEASE WATCH THE VIDEO](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td464dafd-9b0b-4c1f-9f17-dd1828437ebd/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) AND [SUBSCRIBE TO THE TAKEDOWN](https://default.salsalabs.org/T81438522-6b32-4e6c-924a-06dab0e91f92/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)_** **__But right now we're in the election of our lives, with a hostile & sophisticated right-wing disinformation complex that brainwashes people, including those in our lives, with a constant stream of propaganda. A mainstream media so bereft of substance it fails in every facet the Constitution envisioned for it, especially informing the voting populace of the truth without fear or favor. __** **__[That is why I made this video I consider to be the most important of my life. 3 minutes of SHARING FACTS ON WHAT JOE BIDEN AND DEMOCRATCS HAVE ACCOMPLISHED, SO WE REMIND EVERYONE HOW WE MUST VOTE, AND VOTE FOR DEMOCRATS! PLEASE WATCH IT AND, SUBSCRIBE TO THE CHANNEL& SHARE THE VIDEO WITH EVERYONE YOU KNOW. ](https://default.salsalabs.org/T2b90ce17-bae5-43a1-9332-36e4f3082a54/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)__** Did you know ...
* **_PRESIDENT BIDEN CREATED SIX MILLION JOBS IN 2021, AN ALL-TIME RECORD!? _**
* **_JOE BIDEN & DEMOCRATS HAVE CREATED THE MOST MANUFACTURING JOBS IN 30 YEARS!? _**
* **_WITH THE CHILD TAX CREDIT--WHICH EVERY REPUBLICAN OPPOSED--THE BIDEN ADMINISTRATION & DEMOCRATS IN CONGRESS LOWERED CHILDHOOD POVERTY BY THE GREATEST PERCENTAGE EVER!? _**
* **_AFTER A GENERATION OF OTHERS TRYING, JOE BIDEN & DEMOCRATS--AGAIN, WITHOUT A REPUBLICAN VOTE!!--GAVE MEDICARE THE RIGHT TO BULK NEGOTIATE PRESCRIPTION DRUG PRICES _****_AS PART OF THE INFLATION REDUCTION ACT _****_, WHICH WILL LOWER THE PRICE BY AN ESTIMATED 40-50%!?_**

**_[MOST AMERICANS DON'T KNOW THESE FACTS, YOU MAY NOT EVEN KNOW SOME OF THEM. SO I INCLUDED THEM AND MUCH MORE IN THIS VIDEO](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta7e8e74a-d897-44c6-901b-b8533a0a00fb/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)[ AND ASK YOU TO PLEASE WATCH IT](https://default.salsalabs.org/T1c4ae93a-5304-4cab-b0e3-b0fe79f73db7/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) AND LET EVERYONE KNOW THEY MUST VOTE DEMOCRATIC. _** Please share it with everyone you know, those who need to turn out, need to be persuaded, or just are scared about what may happen on Tuesday & need a pick-me-up. **_[GET THIS IN FRONT OF REPUBLICANS, BECAUSE THEY SIMPLY CAN'T DENY ANY OF IT--OH THEY'LL TRY--BUT IT IS, AS THE FAMOUS LINE GOES,"JUST THE FACTS, MA'AM."](https://default.salsalabs.org/T4613b5c7-adb7-494e-ba40-47a019431958/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)_** **_So, no candidate messages here. [Please, just watch the video, share it on every channel and via every email you can](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8cba0399-52d4-48f1-9547-b487fee1ee69/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), [subscribe to the channel](https://default.salsalabs.org/T66f1a975-5eeb-48d5-a20c-85e4640c2dbd/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) and vote!_** **I hope and believe younger voters, voters of color & women turn out in the numbers they did to upend polling on the Kansas Abortion Referendum, in Alaska to defeat Palin and in New York's 19th congressional district, where we turned an 8% polling deficit into a 2% win. But no matter what happens Tuesday, this community will remain & grow. And we'll continue to fight.** **_[PLEASE WATCH THE VIDEO](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tcb3b4e7c-1b78-4ffc-82bf-c2e2a68be641/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) AND [SUBSCRIBE TO THE TAKEDOWN](https://default.salsalabs.org/T1c9221d7-0543-4ba6-be26-61e254fc9635/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)_**** ** **Thank you so much for being here and all you have done to fight for our democracy this past year. Let's finish it off by voting Democratic and winning this thing!!** All my best, Cliff

| | [](https://an.collectivepac.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zfzHF2EoEcnJ6z4SInIYZRWVTxGCHTlic31RArRUvXWMVqG6TavCRLHIF74vzkGGJwZfQYIELhnNY-oCq-_Ot3a0gjcJCSYkSsZyEvyow6uAFvxhXfzIq0DC3IGHOSIDPlmRXkSUBifrwiFm5bXNWW7CNOVJwYAMRnhXAIjRCCdyks0_FTfOvxJvRZgM_JRg7u_5jX6Oa1FMm35yN2kVWkjMcYdzWRODowikc0S8S4nxe6nfTxwTnOo43hXKp9i6MbEdxVvKZtdmbUL5vnnbk5mExX_0ULV8UFLWgRrRN5WVqv0Il68--wC_C8JyOUv_vmPVJvCnlZyOB2hIpnfFMqiznxnwktL2gXxCTIWpIr37Oqu4n3png7KkjgycAbNUg/3qw/hMIssD6kRXGUaoEkDPzw2A/h1/l-KLttDJvVf_juV6tafwlwluXBHNnLsBUK70odXQZyE) There’s no doubt that a record number of Black candidates have run for office on the local, state and federal level across the country this 2021-2022 election cycle and that a record number of Black candidates are officially on the general election ballot. **This election cycle,[The Collective PAC](https://an.collectivepac.org/ss/c/Mqag7sW8TIW-nixyBdulQgQROiIq-nDYJPBPR74FnCdRTNNgcsNLTeiDoTQ_lqbAAju6dzJ4x1f_YLJVV4LMUq8tYGSK9Oemo-YVIlrtK07_shawDwEwzojHteHkw3uzNWQbYFVQukujpwfZ7pVEKjbZ7-DvZCdmVbgqtC0uWw2GHVv5oDqBekWuf0m54_3UU55FRsWVRntv-WjuSzOrI5AyuXbqxENxombfsbD_GDV1PQiF7rrQm5kCZ82wADgvQui9GBp0ld2Q5H6OI_XTX3s93NHn6nzqoMoxckqpO-dtr8Odd8npQOaR0iKQHLXLhTTbFmJVAHenapcdayuWhPOu4CASv9dOaFEeyDKmJSoLRlRRcK1AlW_P7JA4N_XR/3qw/hMIssD6kRXGUaoEkDPzw2A/h2/7wxLD_S2J2KO-PAI5OMT3Koh-7N-7sgivK5PWnfcmhk)** — the nation’s largest political action committee dedicated to increasing Black political engagement, representation and power across all levels of government — **has endorsed, financially supported, and advised 252 Black candidates; with 187 of them on the ballot on November 8th.** As an organization working to change the face of power by closing the representation gap in Black elected leadership at all levels of government, The Collective PAC has maintained a particular **focus this cycle on candidates running in U.S. Senate, Gubernatorial and State Attorneys General races;** supporting candidates including: Mandela Barnes (WI), Cheri Beasley (NC), Charles Booker (KY), Val Demings (FL), Rev. Raphael Warnock (GA), Stacey Abrams (GA), Deidre DeJear (IA), Wes Moore (MD), Aramis Ayala (FL), Keith Ellison (MN), Aaron Ford (NV), and Letitia James (NY) has been our top priority for the 2022 election cycle. **Since our founding in 2016, The Collective PAC has developed a proven track record by helping to elect 314 Black candidates to federal, congressional, statewide, and local offices across the country;** including the elections of: Vice President Kamala Harris; Senator Cory Booker; Senator Raphael Warnock; Attorney General Letitia James (NY); Attorney General Keith Ellison (MN); Attorney General Aaron Ford (NV); Attorney General Kwame Raoul (IL); Lieutenant Governor Garlin Gilchrist (MI); and Lieutenant Governor Mandela Barnes (WI). The Collective PAC’s Work During the 2021-2022 Election Cycle It has never been more evident than in recent years that the time to elect leaders who are ready to take action through powerful progressive policy decisions is now. To this end, **The Collective PAC is working to close the representation gap of Black people at all levels of government to elect leaders that reflect and respect our communities.** Specifically, our in-state work has been focused on **7 priority states: Georgia, North Carolina, Michigan, Florida, Pennsylvania, Texas and Wisconsin** — a combination of traditional battleground states with large Black voter populations and states that present the best opportunities to elect Black candidates to the U.S. Senate and statewide offices, as well as help maintain Democratic majorities in Congress. The Collective PAC’s Investments & Impact The Collective PAC has spent approximately **$700,000** to help elect our candidates through **direct contributions to the campaigns.** We’ve also **bundled $333,823 for federal and statewide candidates.** Investments were contributed directly to campaigns so they can establish and grow their voter outreach and engagement initiatives. Additionally, we’ve highlighted our endorsed candidates through our **email and social media platforms** and worked directly with many of our candidates on **earned media outreach and revamping their social media campaigns.** Beginning in October, **The Collective PAC organized 10 text banks** for some of our high priority races in Arizona, California, Florida, Georgia, Minnesota, Ohio, New York, Nevada, North Carolina, and Wisconsin. Through these organizing efforts, **volunteers were able to reach 2 million Black people** , encouraging them to vote. **Founders of The Collective PAC, Quentin James and Stefanie Brown James, released the following statement:** “The Collective PAC is proud to have 187 endorsed candidates on the ballot on November 8th. We are seeing a record number of Black candidates running for public office and together they represent a new generation of leaders that stand to reshape politics for years to come. These leaders are running for office at a time when their voices and lived experiences can help shape public policy that will improve the lives of all Americans. When we have elected officials who reflect and respect the diversity of our communities, we have a government that is more effective and more responsive to the needs of their constituents. We know that the ripple effect of this election as it pertains to the prowess of Black candidates, will be felt for years to come. This November, voters have the opportunity to elect history making and glass shattering leaders, including the country’s first and second Black woman governors in Stacey Abrams and Deidre Dejear; the U.S. Senate’s first millennial officeholders in Mandela Barnes and Charles Booker; Congress’ first Gen-Z member in Max Frost; and electing two Black women to serve in the U.S. Senate at the same time in Val Demings and Cheri Beasley. | Peter,

**_Exactly 3 DAYS from today, we are going to WIN this race for Governor, because we HAVE to..._**

**_We are going to turn the thousands-strong rallies, the polls that have us within striking distance, the grassroots support that is out-raising Hochul 's powerful pay-to-play allies, and all of the incredible momentum on the ground into a historic victory that saves New York from being lost forever to constant attacks on our wallets, safety, freedom, and kids' education..._**
**BECAUSE LOSING IS _NOT_ AN OPTION!**

| In Kathy Hochul's New York, _law-abiding citizens are forced to live in fear ..._

Three children outside of Buffalo are now having to grow up without a mother, because she refuses to make essential changes to the cashless bail law.

Our streets and subways are being taken over by violent criminals, because she believes your concerns about rising crime are simply "conspiracy theories."

And every day, more and more innocent New Yorkers are becoming victims, because she refuses to look out for our safety and change her soft-on-crime, head in the sand approach to coddling criminals!
**_When you help me take Kathy Hochul 's job just 3 Days from now, that all changes._**
I will declare a Crime Emergency on Day 1, fire Woke DAs who refuse to enforce the law, take action to repeal cashless bail, and ensure that **_CRIMINALS_** are the ones forced to live in fear.

**This historic victory is within reach, friend. We have the potential to save LIVES on Tuesday.[_Are you ready to take our streets back and finally restore a great American state to GLORY? >>_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61803080:6P2SP8GIN:m:1:3359512271:46D601B7A18AE5ABBE4ADB4EF9794814:r)**

| _These final 3 Days of our rescue mission need to be spent working harder than we have over the past 18+ months combined._

Because even though so much is going our way, and Kathy Hochul has alienated herself not just with Republicans, but with Democrats and Independents as well- she is **_STILL_** getting last-minute, emergency support from a national **_Super PAC!_**

That means we need to go into an even higher gear and fight to the finish.
**We would not have been able to get to this point without support from folks like you, friend.[_So will you help us keep it up, continue our Get-Out-The-Vote operations across the state, compete dollar-for-dollar with Hochul and her allies, and stay ALL IN TO SAVE NEW YORK?? >>_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61803080:6P2SP8GIN:m:1:3359512271:46D601B7A18AE5ABBE4ADB4EF9794814:r)**

Hi there -- it’s Sen. Amy Klobuchar. I want to take a moment to talk about the state of our democracy -- and why it’s never been more fragile. Let me explain:
Since 2020, Donald Trump’s big lie that the election was stolen has corroded public trust in our institutions: [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dasspac-nov22?refcode=eem_fr_110522_b4_Klobuchar_30ac&amount=5]

➡ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dasspac-nov22?refcode=eem_fr_110522_b4_Klobuchar_30ac&amount=5] It has sparked a flurry of conspiracy theories.
But instead of denouncing Trump’s big lie, many Republican candidates have doubled down on it and still refuse to accept the results of the last election. And even more shocking, these same election-deniers are running for Secretary of State in swing states across the country.
If elected, they’d be the top officials overseeing election laws and making decisions about when, where and how folks vote.
They’d even have power over certifying the 2024 election results. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dasspac-nov22?refcode=eem_fr_110522_b4_Klobuchar_30ac&amount=5] And since many of these candidates refused to accept the results of the 2020 election, the threat they pose to our democracy is clear.
It’s hard to believe anyone would support throwing away 246 years of democracy, but it’s happening. And next week’s election could determine the future of our democracy for years to come.

subject: Never have I felt such a threat to our democracy.

body:
| | | Friends –

I've spent more than four decades making films that tell America’s stories, and examining the crises—internal and external—that we have faced as a nation, including threats to our democracy.

From the Civil War to the Great Depression, from the First and Second World Wars to the COVID-19 pandemic, these crises have challenged us to live up to the essential promise of our nation, preserving a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.

Today, challenges to our republic are rampant. The democratic values that make up the very fabric of our nation are under assault and at risk of unraveling. It’s never been more important to safeguard our fragile democracy: as Benjamin Franklin so wisely put it, "A Republic, if you can keep it."

That’s why I’m reaching out. With a 50-50 split in the Senate, the fate of our Democratic majority—and our very democracy—hinges on what happens in states like New Hampshire.

name: Laurie Teper
subject: Next up: Election Day!
body:
Hello Team Geels!
We made it through 17 days of early voting! If we win next week, maybe they will change early voting to ONE week in 2024?!?

If you have palm cards left from early voting and you are not volunteering Election Day, please get them to your County Coordinator. WE NEED THEM! If you have them and ARE volunteering, please keep them for your shift.

IF YOU ARE SIGNED UP OR _WILL SIGN UP (PLENTY OF SHIFTS OPEN)_ FOR ELECTION DAY:
Pick up cards and/or buttons (if needed). We have a couple of shirts left:

_Durham County: Renee:_[ 919-880-6810](tel:+19198806810)
Sunday 11/6 2:00pm-2:30pm
Kohl's parking lot
Patterson Place

5241 McFarland Dr. (off Hwy 15-501)

_Alamance County: Corrie_ : [336-578-4059](tel:+13365784059)
Monday 11/7 at Republican Headquarters at 2643 Ramada Rd. Burlington 4:00-6:00.

_Orange County: Laurie: 847-212-5651 or Marianne:_[ 919-740-3503](tel:919-740-3503)
Laurie Teper's house: 2833 Percussion Dr. Hillsborough
Sunday, 11/6 Monday, 11/7 after 3pm call/text 847-212-5651

_PLEASE TEXT OR CALL IF THESE TIMES DON 'T WORK FOR YOU. WE WILL WORK IT OUT._

_Granville County_
Call Ron Conway (Supply Coordinator): 919 527 5860

_Person County_
Call Jason Chambers: [(919) 630-0514](tel:+19196300514)

_If you have not watched this yet, please do_! If you have, it's a good refresher to watch again.
**We strongly encourage you to watch this 25 minute recorded training session by Courtney. She has guidelines she would like you to follow plus she addresses the top 3 questions volunteers have asked.**

[ https://drive.google.com/file/d/1cGV7Ih_iegAaCoTYmKoXyrjyNFhJjjvU/view?ts=6346bd18](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1cGV7Ih_iegAaCoTYmKoXyrjyNFhJjjvU/view?ts=6346bd18)
_
_
**We saw that it moved the percentage toward Courtney****between 3-5% points****at every place we had someone _handing out cards_ at the primaries. You being there matters! Again, we want to reiterate, _they need to be given out, not just shown._**

**Point to the back of the card saying "This is what she stands for. Please consider her before you vote". **
**
**
Please know that we are receiving texts and emails and we ask that you be patient as we get back to you.

_
_
Share this link with potential**volunteers** to sign up:

[https://courtneygeelsforcongress.com/volunteer/](https://courtneygeelsforcongress.com/volunteer/)

Please take videos and photos (in a vertical position) AT THE POLLS and send them to our Social Media Director, Caroline Johnson at [caroline@bluemeraldmedia.com.](http://caroline@bluemeraldmedia.com./)

_
_
Follow us on[Twitter](https://twitter.com/courtneygeels), [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/courtneygeels/), and give us a like on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/CourtneyGeelsForCongress) to keep up with Courtney.

Be sure to like and share!

__Fighting for Truth, Justice and Unity Together!__
Laurie Teper
Volunteer Director
Courtney Geels for Congress NC04
Email: [volunteers@courtneygeelsforcongress.com](mailto:volunteers@courtneygeelsforcongress.com)
Cell: (847)212-5651
[courtneygeelsforcongress.com](http://courtneygeelsforcongress.com)

subject: I don't come from a wealthy family. My mom was a public school teacher and my dad worked third shift at General Motors. Those jobs were our family's ticket to the middle class.
