| | | | | Peter, My path to running for U.S. Senate was different than most. I don't come from a wealthy family. I didn't enter this race with a bunch of mega-donors lining up to write big checks to this campaign. My mom was a public school teacher and my dad worked third shift at General Motors. Those jobs were our family's ticket to the middle class. Ever since I was a little kid, my parents taught me never to settle for what is, but to reach for what can be. It was how I graduated high school at the age of 16 and went on to be elected to the Wisconsin State Assembly when I was 25. And it's how I won Wisconsin’s Lieutenant Governor race in 2018 and helped beat Scott Walker. Then, after careful thought and consideration, I decided to get in this U.S. Senate race to defeat Ron Johnson. It was a big decision. I knew that this was going to be one of the most competitive races in the entire country. And it is a race that we must win if we're going to defend and expand the Democratic Senate majority. I was willing to bet that if I decided to run, people like you would come together in large numbers to help fund this campaign. Because the truth is that no single person can flip Wisconsin's Senate seat alone. It will only happen if we're in this together. **[With $31 million in attack ads against me so far, I urgently need your support in order to have the resources to take on the right-wing super PACs and win on Tuesday.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tab7ed167-1e2c-4cb7-a109-1e70a22594a9/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** So I’m asking:

I didn't enter this race with a bunch of mega-donors lining up to write big checks to this campaign. My mom was a public school teacher and my dad worked third shift at General Motors. Those jobs were our family's ticket to the middle class. Ever since I was a little kid, my parents taught me never to settle for what is, but to reach for what can be. It was how I graduated high school at the age of 16 and went on to be elected to the Wisconsin State Assembly when I was 25. body:
I had Mark by my side.
#

Friends —
I’ve known the darkest of days. But confronted by despair, I summoned hope.
I have always loved connecting with people. Meeting them, singing with them, laughing with them. And then suddenly, I could not speak. My life changed forever.
It would have been easy to give up. But I was lucky. I had Mark by my side.
In the early days of my recovery, Mark wasn’t just my husband — he was my champion. My rock. And with him and a community of family, friends, nurses, doctors, and specialists, I kept moving forward. It took time and determination, but I found my voice again.
That is what Mark does. He brings people together, and he won’t ever give up on you. There will always be dark days, but with Mark I have hope. With Mark by my side I know I can make it through.
I know how special it is to have someone like Mark in your corner. I know how special it is to have so many supporters from all over in your corner, too. And I know how important it is to ask for help if you need it.
Now is one of those times: A new poll came out yesterday that has Mark down by 1%. With the election just days away, Mark needs you now more than ever.
[**So please, chip in $3 or whatever you can afford before Election Day. It would mean the world to Mark.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-nov22.ftVLpg&refcode=em221105-3-7&t=1&akid=4703%2E6688874%2EkSPE-k)

| Dear Kansans,

The time has come to make a choice. What kind of leadership do you want in America? Do you want more of the same? That means more inflation, open borders, higher taxes, an all-out assault on the right to life, and our children being indoctrinated in schools with a woke, leftist, socialist agenda.

God bless Kansas, and God bless America.

Rep. Tracey Mann

name: Justin Kwasa, LCV
subject: Add Your Name: Count Every Vote!
body:
It's every voter's right to have their voice heard and ballot counted. Sign and pass it on. |
---
| | **
EVERY VOICE MATTERS. EVERY VOTE COUNTS.**
Voting is in our name and is core to our mission. We need to make sure every vote is counted. Are you in?

Can you add your name -- and share as widely as you can -- if you believe every vote should be counted?
|
---
**[**ADD YOUR NAME:
COUNT EVERY VOTE **](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/w_)**

** **
|
Peter -- In the wake of an unsuccessful attempt to illegally overturn the 2020 election on January 6, 2021, Trump supporters set legal traps to ensure they could have their way in 2022.

Across the country, 21 state legislatures enacted over 42 laws that restricted our basic freedom to vote -- using the unproven "Big Lie" as "proof." These laws strategically targeted communities that have long been impacted by voter suppression tactics and disenfranchisement: low-wealth communities and communities of color.

**Their plan is to discount as many votes as possible.** That's why it's so important that we unite as a country and make it clear that counting every vote is the will of the people. Every ballot, whether mailed in, dropped off, or cast in-person, MUST be counted. Being patient and taking the time to ensure everyone's voice is heard is the MOST important thing we can demand right now -- will you speak up?

[Add your name and pass it on: Every vote counts.](https://links.messages.lcv.)

_For many key races across the country, we won't know the final results on Election Day._

The growing usage of absentee ballots -- which often take longer to count thanks to anti-voter state legislatures not allowing them to be counted as they come in -- means that it could take days to determine a winner in some states. While the delay is frustrating for all of us, we must remember that a slow, correct count is better than a fast, disputed one. We need to support election officials that are taking the necessary time to get it right.

But there's one thing we _do_ know that's central to all of us at the League of Conservation Voters: EVERYONE deserves the right for their vote to be counted.

[Add your name and make it clear you demand a free and fair election where every vote is counted, then share with your friends and family.](https://links.messages.lcv.)

Our elections determine the future we build -- a world with safe water, clean air, and a real chance for climate action -- or one of science denial, toxic pollution, and environmental racism.

Our communities' health, rights, and environment depend on our democracy's health, and our democracy is strongest when it includes all of us.

No one should be silenced because of how or where their ballot is cast. Today, we ask you to join our call to count every vote so everyone's voice is heard.

[Election officials need time to count every single eligible vote -- will you add your name and share as widely as you can now?](https://links.messages.lcv.)

Thanks for doing your part, and we'll keep you updated on more opportunities to take action. It's up to all of us to do everything we can to ensure every vote is counted.

Sincerely,

Justin Kwasa
Democracy Program Director
League of Conservation Voters
|

We need to make sure every vote is counted. Are you in? Can you add your name -- and share as widely as you can -- if you believe every vote should be counted? | | Peter -- In the wake of an unsuccessful attempt to illegally overturn the 2020 election on January 6, 2021, Trump supporters set legal traps to ensure they could have their way in 2022. Across the country, 21 state legislatures enacted over 42 laws that restricted our basic freedom to vote -- using the unproven "Big Lie" as "proof." These laws strategically targeted communities that have long been impacted by voter suppression tactics and disenfranchisement: low-wealth communities and communities of color. Their plan is to discount as many votes as possible. That's why it's so important that we unite as a country and make it clear that counting every vote is the will of the people. Every ballot, whether mailed in, dropped off, or cast in-person, MUST be counted. Being patient and taking the time to ensure everyone's voice is heard is the MOST important thing we can demand right now -- will you speak up? For many key races across the country, we won't know the final results on Election Day. The growing usage of absentee ballots -- which often take longer to count thanks to anti-voter state legislatures not allowing them to be counted as they come in -- means that it could take days to determine a winner in some states. While the delay is frustrating for all of us, we must remember that a slow, correct count is better than a fast, disputed one. We need to support election officials that are taking the necessary time to get it right. But there's one thing we do_ know that's central to all of us at the League of Conservation Voters: EVERYONE deserves the right for their vote to be counted. Our elections determine the future we build -- a world with safe water, clean air, and a real chance for climate action -- or one of science denial, toxic pollution, and environmental racism. Our communities' health, rights, and environment depend on our democracy's health, and our democracy is strongest when it includes all of us. No one should be silenced because of how or where their ballot is cast. Today, we ask you to join our call to count every vote so everyone's voice is heard. Thanks for doing your part, and we'll keep you updated on more opportunities to take action. It's up to all of us to do everything we can to ensure every vote is counted. Sincerely, Justin Kwasa Democracy Program Director League of Conservation Voters | | This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. If this isn't the best email address at which to reach you, . from our supporter list. Send us any comments, criticisms, or feedback mailto:feedback@lcv.org, or just reply to this email! Thanks for your support. |

The biggest new conservative spender was AIPAC’s super PAC, called the “United Democracy Project.” **This is the super PAC that dropped $1 million in PA-12 in just four days — after spending $2.3 million attacking Summer during her primary.** We can’t afford to lose out on sending a progressive champion like Summer to Congress because of dark money attacks like this. **Which is why we’re launching a new ad in response to remind voters who’s really in their corner.** **** **[Can you rush a donation right now so we can fight back and reach as many voters as possible in Summer’s district? clean_body: Lopsided resource advantages are hard to overcome. | | | In just the past few days, a super PAC has spent more than $1 million attacking WFP champion Summer Lee. Let us rewind for just a moment, Peter: Earlier this year, we saw an unprecedented avalanche of right wing and corporate super PAC spending. The biggest new conservative spender was AIPAC’s super PAC, called the “United Democracy Project.” This is the super PAC that dropped $1 million in PA-12 in just four days — after spending $2.3 million attacking Summer during her primary. We can’t afford to lose out on sending a progressive champion like Summer to Congress because of dark money attacks like this. Which is why we’re launching a new ad in response to remind voters who’s really in their corner. ** We know that progressives can get outspent and still win — Summer proved it last May when she pulled ahead to win the Democratic primary for PA-12. But it’s one thing to be outspent 2-1; it’s something else entirely to get outspent 5-1 or 10-1. This kind of lopsided resource advantage is hard for anyone to overcome and we saw its devastating effect in other House races. AIPAC and the United Democracy Project have made their values clear. They are supporting an extremist Republican who will vote to ban abortion, attack Medicare, and cut Social Security. Summer Lee couldn’t be more different from that, Peter. She’s a native Pennsylvanian, and a history-making community organizer and public servant, who will continue the fight to raise the minimum wage, create sustainable jobs, strengthen abortion rights, and win racial and gender equity. With just three days left until Election Day, we’re doing everything we can to help Summer fight back against this onslaught, while showing everyone we can take on big corporate money and win. Thank you for your support in these critical final days, Peter. In solidarity, Working Families Party Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. Reply directly to this email and let us know. subject: I'm urgently asking you to make a $3 contribution before voters go to the polls in Wisconsin
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Mandela Barnes for Wisconsin
body:
The only way we are going to raise what it takes to win is from lots and lots of people chipping in.
#
Friends -
One of the hardest parts of running for Senate is the absurd amount of money that it takes to build a successful campaign.
Let me be clear: I am not accepting any corporate PAC money. And I don't have a bunch of billionaire mega-donors waiting in the wings.
**The only way we are going to raise what it takes to win is from lots and lots of people making an unprecedented number of small donations.** That is quite frankly our path to victory.
Election Day is quickly approaching, and we've got some big goals to meet before then. Since you're an important part of this team, I hope you will consider adding a contribution today.
[**Can you make a $3 contribution today to help flip Wisconsin's Senate seat and defend the Democratic Senate majority? Any amount helps.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mandela-em-nov22.Jaf-Cy&refcode=em221105-4-nor&t=1&akid=3996%2E196590%2EAPD8Da)
_If you 've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_
[Express Donate: $3](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1272?c0=mandela-em-nov22.7nX-eC&refcode=em221105-4-nor&t=20&akid=3996%2E196590%2EAPD8Da)
[Express Donate: $25](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1273?c0=mandela-em-nov22.6Wmf9O&refcode=em221105-4-nor&t=21&akid=3996%2E196590%2EAPD8Da)

[Express Donate: $250](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1266?c0=mandela-em-nov22.6Ri53w&refcode=em221105-4-nor&t=24&akid=3996%2E196590%2EAPD8Da)
[Or donate another amount](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mandela-em-nov22.Jaf-Cy&refcode=em221105-4-nor&t=25&akid=3996%2E196590%2EAPD8Da)
As long as we build the largest grassroots campaign that Wisconsin has ever seen, we are going to be unstoppable against Ron Johnson on Election Day.
Your contribution today will go a long way toward ensuring we have what it takes to win this race. Thanks for chipping in, if you can afford it.
All my best,
Mandela
P.S. When I made the decision to reject corporate PAC money, I was banking on the fact that people like you would help fund this campaign. | | Friend,

Joe Biden, John Sarbanes and their friends in Congress have made quite a mess.

40-year high inflation, soaring gas prices, and rising crime are plaguing the entire nation. They know voters are going to send a clear change message on Tuesday, and now they are throwing a desperate Hail Mary by sending surrogates around the country.

They never expected races like mine against a 15-year incumbent to be close, but now they are in an all-out panic.

President Biden and the First Lady will be in Maryland on Monday to beg Democrats to turn out and vote.
